- Apply only through our official channels. Â We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:Â https://tether.recruitee.com/ 

- Verify the recruiterâs identity. Â All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If youâre unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. 

- Be cautious of unusual communication methods. Â We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. 

- Double-check email addresses. Â All communication from us will come from emails ending inÂ @ tether.to orÂ @ tether.io 

- We will never request payment or financial details. Â If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. 

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Product Design Lead
description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 

If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 

What you'll do: - Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
- Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
- Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
- Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
- Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
- Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
- Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
- Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
- Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 

What you'll bring: - Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
- Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
- Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
- The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
- The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
- Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
- Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
- Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
- Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
- Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
- An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 
You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 

- A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
- A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
- Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
- A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
- Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie? Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

- We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
- We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
- We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â 
- We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â 
Application process: If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â 

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â 

This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â

title: Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager is a client-facing role at the center of everything we do.

Running high-impact A/B tests requires coordination across many disciplinesâresearch, strategy, design, copywriting, development, QA, analytics, and client stakeholders. Your job is to keep everything moving forward, aligned, and energized.

Key Responsibilities

Youâll own three core responsibilities:

- Coordination . Youâll manage cross-functional teams of 5â10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea â build â launch â analysis. Youâll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

- Strategy & Planning. Youâll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10â20 upcoming experiments. Youâll communicate the âwhyâ behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings.

- Energy (âVibesâ). Youâre the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.

Skills, Knowledge and Traits

You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Hereâs what we need from you:

Responsibilities

title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

Â 

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Â 

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Â 

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do 

- Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

- Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

- Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

- Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

- Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

- Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

- Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

- Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for 

- Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

- Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

- AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

- High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

- Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

- Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit 

- Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

- MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

- Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting 

- Competitive, top-of-market compensation

- You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

- Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

- Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. - Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription. 

- Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus. 

Why Now 

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

Â 

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Â 

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Â 

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada. 

Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n 

Responsibilities 

- 
Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

- 
Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

- 
Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

- 
Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

- 
Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

- 
Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability

Requirements 

- 
A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

- 
Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

- 
Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

- 
Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

- 
Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

- 
Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities

Pluses 

- 
Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

- 
Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

- 
Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

- 
Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

- 
Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

- 
Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives. 

The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n 

Responsibilities: 
- Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.

- Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.

- Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.

- Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.

- Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.

- Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.

- Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.

- Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.

- Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.

- Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.

Experience:

description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.** 

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. Role Overview 

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities 

- Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

- Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

- Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

- Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

- Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

- Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

- Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.

Required Experience 

- At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

- Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

- Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

- Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills 

- Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

- Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

- Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

- Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

- Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

- Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

ROLE OVERVIEW 

The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. Operating at the intersection of our product suite and our customers, this dynamic role focuses on translating our product capabilities into effective solutions to match our customers' scientific use cases, and enabling the broader CX organization to operationalize around Benchling's best practices. title: Director Media (Mensch)
description:
About WPP Media 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das bieten wir dir:

Als Director Media (Mensch) übernimmst du die strategische und operative Verantwortung für einen unserer namhaften Kunden. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team betreust du das Budgetvolumen für zukunftweisende Mediakampagnen.

- Expertise in Mediaberatung: Du bringst mehrjährige (ca. 6–8+ Jahre) relevante Erfahrung in der Mediastrategie und Kundenberatung aus dem Agenturumfeld mit.

- Leadership: Du verfügst über fundierte Führungserfahrung, verstehst es, Teams zu begeistern sowie zu befähigen, und führst mit Empathie und Klarheit.

- Komplexitäts- & Budgetstärke: Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung großer Etats und bewegst dich souverän in vielschichtigen Kunden- und Konzernstrukturen.

- Sprachkompetenz: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für den regelmäßigen Austausch auf europäischer Ebene sind für dich selbstverständlich.

Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tools & Systems
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role: 
We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering. 

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems. 

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering. 

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership. 

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role. 

What you'll do: 

- Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering. 

- Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools. 

- Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency. 

- Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries. 

- Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions. 

- Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams. 

What you'll bring: 
Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below. 

- Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful. 

- Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform. 

- Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling. 

- Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions. 

- Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use. 

How you work: 

- You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state. 

- You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve. 

- You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns. 

- You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment. 

- You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas. 

What you’ll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 

- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage 

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together 

- Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday 

- One-time home office stipend 

- Annual professional development budget 

- Quarterly well-being stipend 

- Considerable paid parental leave 

- Employee referral bonus program 

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) 

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging 

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Senior Consulting Systems Engineer Germany, Strategic Accounts (Automotive and Manufacturing)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

Senior Consulting Systems Engineer Germany, Strategic Accounts 

(Automotive) 

Do you keep up with the latest trends, are you a disruptive thinker and do you have experience of driving cultural change in organisations? If Yes - then this is the right role for you.

The Strategic Accounts business is the growth area for Everpure and the Client Technical Director (CTD), known internally as a - Consulting System Engineer (CSE) - is a key role in engaging new and existing Automotive clients in conversations to help them transition from traditional storage-centric models to a modern data platform - unlocking the power of their data.

As Client Technical Director you are a senior level technical Solutions Architect who will work with and focus on Everpure’s Strategic clients - for this role it will be German Automotive clients with a focus on southern Germany, plus other selected accounts. In turn, you will also work in collaboration with Everpure’s Enterprise and Field pre-sales and account teams 

You are expected also to have a detailed grasp of IT industry trends, broad and deep IT industry experience (especially Automotive, their Tier 1 suppliers and ecosystems, plus the wider Manufacturing supply chain and build demands) and a high degree of business acumen and will be working in the forefront of Everpure's global sales capability.

You will be required to work closely with your customer base (so frequent travel within Germany is a strong requirement), building a trusted relationship, identifying and quantifying outcome based opportunities that can be delivered from our portfolio.

You must be knowledgeable across industry, business, IT strategy, use cases and technology domains and be comfortable presenting to C-Suite clients, discussing process with business managers or working with developers on solution strategy, architecture and code, and with storage admins designing operating models – from boardroom to hackathon to storage ops. Critically you will be accustomed to creating a value proposition that is directly linked to a client’s business model, challenges and issues plus their future vision.

You will be an expert in quickly learning new business models and drivers and will be able to articulate, to multiple customer stakeholder personas across different regions and countries. This will include presenting and explaining the benefits and differentiators of our chosen technology, how our solution has been mapped to meet their industry, business and operational requirements, our implementation methods, and the proposed commercial and financial models.

Building and articulating financial and commercial models with their benefits to our customers, and internal stakeholders is a key aspect of the ever evolving role.

It is expected that you will be able to translate our core values, differentiators and capabilities across our portfolio, plus articulate previous customer success stories, benefits seen and acknowledged by customers with known outcomes to multiple levels of stakeholders within the strategic accounts.

You have gravitas and authenticity. You will be expected to have first class interpersonal skills combined with a comfortable, open and compelling communication and presentation style. You also bring a high degree of diplomacy and a strong EQ. It is imperative that we can look at our value propositions from the viewpoint of our customers, therefore empathy is critical.

SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE, AS A CTD AT EVERPURE YOU WILL WORK ON... 

- Use Case Development and Solution Definition: 

Define end‑to‑end solutions and use cases that address the specific realities of German and global Automotives – from production and supply chain to digital services and connected vehicles.

Shape our global automotive strategy and footprint across the largest German OEMs and suppliers by mapping industry trends, business drivers, and technical requirements to Everpure’s portfolio and ecosystem.

Influence implementation methods, technology choices and commercial / financial models so that our solutions deliver clear, measurable outcomes for customers.

- Stakeholder Management: 

Understand stakeholders, their drivers, challenges, their goals and expectations, and effectively communicate the right messages to them. You will spend a large portion of your time with your customers face to face, (in and around Germany primarily, but also globally covering the leading German Automotive accounts), your partners, Alliances, Global Integrators and key stakeholders.

- Financial Acumen: 

Calculate Total Cost of Ownership scenarios for customers, explaining how they align with their challenges and Everpure’s benefits.

- Leadership and Collaboration: 

Lead large IT projects, establish yourself as a thought leader and trusted advisor, collaborate with sales, engineering, and product management teams. Have experience of working across multiple global and local partners.

- Collateral Production :

Create client collateral, including presentations, papers, demonstrations, proofs of concepts, and contribute to joint offerings with other Everpure teams.

- Sales Guidance: 

Guide the Sales team in positioning, shaping and closing the right solutions in a competitive environment.

- Technical Leadership: 

Provide technical leadership and mentoring for the local and regional Systems Engineering organisation.

Represent Pure at industry events, field marketing activities and communities (including those focused on women in tech and diverse talent).

- Market Insight: 

Track key trends in Automotive and Manufacturing (e.g. software‑defined vehicles ADAS & AD, Industry 4.0, sustainability, data sovereignty and primacy & AI) and connect them to Everpure’s technology strategy.

Understand the competitive landscape and be able to articulate where Pure differentiates and how our solutions support the German market’s specific requirements.

Bring back customer and market insights to influence our roadmap and go‑to‑market.

- Culture & Inclusion: 

Help maintain and evolve Everpure’s technical and customer‑first culture .

Act as a role model who creates inclusive environments , supports diverse talent, and helps us attract and retain top technical people

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE... 

1.Technical Expertise: 

Strong technical background across infrastructure and data : storage, compute, databases, networking, virtualisation and/or cloud‑native architectures.

Solid experience with data management and storage technologies , and how they support mission‑critical workloads in Automotive and Manufacturing.

Understanding of key manufacturing processes and outcomes , and a deep appreciation of the Automotive value chain – OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers, production plants, logistics and digital services.

- Versatility: 

Familiarity with areas such as data & analytics / data science, modern IT architecture modelling, Agile and DevOps, automation and infrastructure as code, IT operations and IT security .

Ability to quickly learn new platforms, tools and architectures and translate them into simple, business‑relevant language .

- Strategic Thinking: 

Experience working with large, global or strategic accounts – ideally in or with German enterprise customers (automotive experience is beneficial)

Ability to move comfortably between big‑picture strategy and hands‑on detail , and to structure complex problems into clear options and recommendations.

- Communication Skills: 

Outstanding communication skills in German and English (Native/Bilingual German and business‑fluent English required).

Confidence in presenting to C‑Level, senior business leaders and technical teams – and in facilitating workshops where different perspectives need to be heard.

High emotional intelligence, empathy and diplomacy ; you naturally build trust and foster collaborative discussions.

- Industry Knowledge :

Strong understanding of commercial and disruptive technology trends in the Automotive and Manufacturing markets in Germany, with existing relationships within southern Germany automotives strongly preferred.

Knowledge of major competitors and partner ecosystems , and the ability to position Pure’s differentiators for the right use cases.

- Learning Orientation: 

A growth and learning orientation – you actively invest in your own development and stay curious about new technologies, methods and industry trends.

Willingness to dedicate a minimum of 10% of your time to training, certifications and participation in industry and community events.

#LI-HYBRID

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US: 

- Innovation : We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to the VP of Global GTM. - Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) .

- Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees.

- Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP’s regional field teams.

Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.Languages: Professional fluency in both German and English (written and spoken). 

What You will get: 

- You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, an attractive salary and extensive benefits (including JobRad, Focus Friday and much more).

- You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.

- We support our employees with 5 fully paid sick days per child and subsidize childcare up to primary school age.

- In addition to an individual onboarding and buddy program, we offer comprehensive training opportunities and english language classes.

- We offer 30 days of paid vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) for optimal work-life balance.

- Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.

- Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.

- The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world’s leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager  | Germany | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity: 

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing: 

- Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.

- Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.

- Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.

- Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.

- Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit: 

- 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)

- Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience

- A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies 

- Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish

- Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike

- Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team

- Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows

- Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes

- Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging

- Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations.

- Exceptional writing and communication skills

- A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact 

Compensation & Rewards: 

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 97,034 - EUR 116,441. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 

- 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

- Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

- Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

- Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

- Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

- Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

- Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

- Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

- Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

- In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 

- Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

title: Senior Application Product Manager - Supply Chain - Procurement

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team: 

The Celonis Business Apps Supply Chain team is an innovative group of product and technology enthusiasts focused on creating and deploying next-generation solutions in the Supply Chain domain. We are transforming how enterprise solutions are built driven by our customers' business critical problems. Our team strikes an ideal balance between deep technical execution (including advanced data engineering and AI tooling) and a sharp customer focus to create highly impactful products that accelerate value realization across our customer base.

The Role: 

You will gain experience in the Supply Chain and related processes and act as the interface between customers, our Go-To-Market and our Product & Engineering teams, shaping the future of Celonis’ product offering in this domain. Take this chance to rethink the way companies run their Supply Chain processes, with a specific focus on Procurement and help our customers to accelerate their value realization with Celonis.

As an Application Product Manager for Procurement, you will operate at the intersection of customer-facing solution engineering and core product innovation to architect and deploy cutting-edge enterprise AI solutions. In this hybrid role, you will partner directly with strategic customers to build bespoke, composable procurement and supply chain architectures using the Celonis Context Model (CCM) and advanced decision intelligence. By leveraging modern AI tooling and LLM-based coding agents, you will abstract field insights into reusable semantic libraries, directly accelerating Celonis' global agentic deployment workflows. You get hands-on: prototyping on the platform, wiring up data, building AI-driven solutions, and iterating directly with the people who'll use them.

The work you’ll do: 

Your mission is to make the vision of AI-powered solutions a reality by building products that turn the cutting edge capabilities of the Celonis Platform from strategy into solutions that customers use to run their Procurement processes.

- Discovery & Solution Blueprinting: Conduct collaborative discovery workshops to uncover root-causes and operational inefficiencies, mapping ambiguous customer needs into clear technical scopes and comprehensive solution blueprints.

- Context Model & Solution Deployment: Execute hands-on deployments of customer-specific context models, data structures, and end-to-end supply chain blueprints within the Celonis platform.

- Project Management & Customer Value: Own customer deployments end-to-end from initial kickoff to live production, presenting complex architectural solutions and strategic value narratives directly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive teams.

- Prototype & Test Functions: Design, validate, and test use-case-specific decision intelligence functions, including e.g. optimization algorithms and predictive models.

- Context Generation: Deconstruct monolithic application architectures and translate deployment learnings into reusable semantic entities and modular context libraries.

title: Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves 

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀 

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process , and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here 

Your mission as an Analytics Engineer 

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong data engineering skills to join our Data team and help build a scalable, reliable, and well-structured data foundation across Appinio.
In this role, you will design and maintain clean, scalable data models that make data easy to access, understand, and use across the organisation. You will use SQL, dbt, and Python to transform raw data into meaningful datasets, develop automated workflows, and ensure consistency and reliability across our data warehouse.
Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure.
Working closely with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and business teams, you will help define and standardise key business metrics such as revenue, bookings, and churn, ensuring a single source of truth across the company. You will also take ownership of data quality through automated testing, validation, and monitoring across the data lifecycle.
You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. You will also help prepare our data foundation for AI-driven analytics by ensuring that data models, business definitions, and documentation are structured, consistent, and accessible.
You will contribute to documentation, performance optimisation, and the continuous improvement of our data stack, helping us build a robust and scalable data platform that enables teams across Appinio to make faster, more informed decisions.

What you’ll be doing 

- Data Modeling: Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models in the data warehouse using SQL and dbt, making data accessible and reliable for analysts and business users.

- Data Transformation: Develop and maintain data transformation workflows, turning raw data from multiple sources into structured, analytics-ready datasets.

- Data Pipelines & Integration: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliable data ingestion from APIs, databases, and third-party systems into the data warehouse.

- Data Quality & Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by implementing automated tests, validations, monitoring, and proactive issue resolution across data pipelines and models.

- Documentation: Document data models, pipelines, business definitions, and transformation logic to ensure transparency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing.

- Business Logic Ownership: Define, implement, and standardize key business metrics (e.g. revenue, bookings, churn) to ensure consistency across reporting and analytics.

- Collaboration: Work closely with analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.

- Performance & Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize SQL queries, dbt models, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and efficient use of data warehouse resources.

You will thrive in this role if 

- Strong SQL & Data Modeling Skills: You have excellent SQL skills and hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data models in a modern data warehouse.

- Experience with dbt: You have practical experience using dbt to develop, test, document, and maintain reliable data transformation workflows.

- Data Engineering & Python: You are proficient in Python and have experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines, including integrations with APIs, databases, and third-party systems.

- Data Warehousing Knowledge: You understand modern data warehouse architectures and have experience working with cloud-based solutions such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.

- Data Quality & Reliability: You have a strong understanding of data quality principles, automated testing, validation, and monitoring, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

- Business Understanding: You can translate business requirements into reliable data models and clearly defined metrics, balancing technical quality with practical business needs.

- Problem-Solving & Ownership: You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges, investigating root causes, and developing sustainable solutions.

- Collaboration & Communication: You communicate technical concepts clearly, work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and enjoy collaborating across teams.

- AI & Automation Mindset: You are curious about AI-powered development tools and actively explore opportunities to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity.

What’s in it for you? 

- Flexibility Policy - Average is 30 days taken, however, we do not have a hard cap of number of vacation days as we know life happens 

- Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year 

- All the hardware you need and your own MacBook 

- If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space 

- Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location

- In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces 

Additional role details 

- This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in Germany, the UK, Portugal, the Netherlands, and Spain

- This role will report directly to our Team Lead, Business Intelligence

Our interview process 

- Screening Call with the Talent Acquisition team

- Hiring Manager interview

- Case Study 

- Executive Interview

- References

Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English.

This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm. 

Appinio is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.
