title: Senior Python Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017 

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs 

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot )

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. 

Join us if you want to

- Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

- Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

- Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We’re looking for a full-stack Python engineer to join our Central Operations team.

Central Ops sits across our core products (Cards, Loans and Motor), focusing on shared operational challenges and opportunities. We build a mix of internally facing web applications and robust automations to help our Operations teams deliver great outcomes for customers, efficiently and at scale.

It’s a broad space: Operations makes up roughly half of our employee headcount and covers everything from day-to-day customer support up to complex areas like Fraud and Fincrime prevention. As our customer base grows rapidly, our role is to help ops keep pace without relying solely on headcount growth. We make intelligent, pragmatic use of AI where it adds real value, working closely with Product, Data Science and Analytics to deploy solutions that genuinely support our ops agents.

You’ll have real ownership from an engineering perspective, shipping features that are used daily by Ops teams. It’s an evolving space at Lendable, and what you build will help shape both our tools and our technical direction.

Some examples of things we’ve built recently: 

- Rebuilt our Ops QA admin system from the ground up, replacing an off-the-shelf tool with something tailored to our needs

- Deployed a pipeline to summarise customer calls into concise notes using LLMs, automatically surfaced in ops admin panels — removing the need for manual note-writing

- More than doubled the number of complaints processed by agents through a combination of targeted AI automation and improved UX

What we’re looking for

We’d consider the following essential to the role:

- You have 8+ years of professional experience as a software engineer

- Solid experience with Python in a web application context. You have some experience with web frameworks like FastAPI, Django or Flask. We use FastAPI.

- Experience with Javascript/Typescript and a modern JS framework such as React, Angular or Vue.js. We generally use React & NextJS. You can build a frontend that's good enough for internal tooling

- Strong engineering principles & practices: design patterns, testing, clean code and a good reviewer

- Previous experience working in a product-focused team

- A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team

- You use AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, Claude or others in your day-to-day coding

The following are also a plus, but by no means essential. If you don’t meet all of these, please apply anyway!

- Exposure to Domain Driven Design, Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS

- SQL, and finding your way around data schemas

- Shipping containerised software with Argo, Kubernetes, Docker and Terraform

Interview process 

- A 30 minute introductory call

- Take Home Task

- Technical Interview 

- Cultural/behavioural interview

Life at Lendable

- Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

- Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

- Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

- Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

- Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

- Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

- Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

- Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Software Engineer, Web (Full stack)
description:
We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts with a high sense of ownership. This commitment to expertise is an expectation for every team member.

As a Web Engineer, your day-to-day will include: 

Platform Engineering 

Designing and building robust, scalable web platforms end-to-end in TypeScript: APIs, services, data access layers and the UI on top of them. You’ll make the architectural decisions and set the patterns that others build on.

Workflows & Data Pipelines 

Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

Data Modeling & Visualization 

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. You’ll handle data with privacy in mind from the very first design decision.

Maps & Geospatial Data 

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

Roadmap Creation and Ideation 

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

Owning your scope 

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.

Your Skills & Experience: 

Please indicate your years of experience on the application form.

- 7+ years of professional experience building SaaS products or data-heavy platforms.

- High proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in modern web frameworks (React, Next.js…).

- Strong experience with Postgres and data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).

- Solid understanding of data modeling for analytics and for visualizing large volumes of data.

- A privacy-aware approach to handling sensitive data, such as aggregation and anonymization.

- Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend.

- Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running processes (Restate, Temporal, or similar) is a big plus.

- Expertise in map rendering and geospatial data visualization (Mapbox GL, MapLibre, deck.gl , or similar) is a big plus.

- Experience with WebGL or GPU rendering is a plus.

- Comfortable working closely with backend and data teams across a polyglot stack is a plus.

- Knowledge of infrastructure (Bazel, GCP, Kubernetes) is a plus.

- Passion and experience building great products. We’d love to hear about things you’ve shipped!

AI as a multiplier 

AI is part of how we build every day. We’re looking for engineers with a real grasp of these tools, who use them to multiply their output and not to make up for missing expertise. You should be able to drive an agent through a complex change, judge what it produces, spot where it’s subtly wrong, and stand behind every line that ships.

The bar 

We’re looking for exceptional engineers, and we set the bar high on purpose. In return, you’ll get real ownership from day one, products used by millions of people, a team that ships in days rather than quarters, a modern stack with top-tier tooling, and colleagues who will push you to grow.

You don’t need to speak French to apply (and you don’t need perfect English; we’ll help you ramp up quickly).

Life at amo: 

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

- We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

- We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

Relocation

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
About Orakl Oncology 

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials and every failure costs patients years.

Orakl exists to change those odds. We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients: real patients’ tumors, paired with their medical history and deep biological data. Because we can test treatments on these virtual patients at scale, we can predict, with causal evidence, how a patient will respond to a drug long before it reaches the clinic. This helps pharma companies bet on the right drugs, for the right patients, much earlier on.

We were founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès and Gustave Ronteix, PhD as a spin-out from Gustave Roussy, one of Europe’s leading cancer centers, and we build on 10 years of research. We are backed by top international VCs and growing fast. Discover more here on Orakl’s website .

The role 

Orakl is looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to build and run its partnership pipeline with pharma and biotech. You will find the right accounts, reach the right people inside them and turn first conversations into qualified opportunities for the VP Business Development. You will own the front end of Orakl’s commercial engine: account strategy, prospecting, discovery and pipeline discipline. You will work closely with the VP BD, the Product Marketer, the scientific teams and the founders, and alongside the Communications & Events Lead on conferences.

- Define where Orakl plays. Identify and prioritise the pharma and biotech accounts where Orakl’s offerings create the most value, based on their oncology pipelines and development stage.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - Draft Showdown
description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available.

Team

For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become.

You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding.

You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you.

This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game.
You will be central to that transition.

Role

You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that.

Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will:

- Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server.

- Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted.

- Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture

- Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities.

The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang).

To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions.

Profile

- 5+ years of backend development experience

- Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals

- Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment) 

- Mastery of SQL and NoSQL

- Background in high-scale systems

- Understanding of Unix-like environments

- AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

- Experience working in cross-functional agile teams

- Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments.

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders.

- Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously.

- A deep interest in game development is a plus.

- Based or willing to relocate in Paris

Benefits

- Best-in-class compensation

- Other benefits according to the country you reside

title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F) 

À propos de notre client 

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste 

Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes.

Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations.

Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. 

Vos missions

- Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules.
- Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression.
- Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces.
- Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer.
- Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais.
- Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle.
Requirements 

Indispensable

- Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé).
- Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer.
- Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements.

Important

- Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs.
- Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés.

Un plus

- Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers).
- Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique.
- Expérience en pression ou température.

À propos de notre client 

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste 

Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes.

Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations.

Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. 

Vos missions

- Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules.
- Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression.
- Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces.
- Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer.
- Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais.
- Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle.

Indispensable

- Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé).
- Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer.
- Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements.

Important

- Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs.
- Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés.

Un plus

- Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers).
- Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique.
- Expérience en pression ou température.

Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description 

Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods.

We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities 

- Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction.

- Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands.

- Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights.

- Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale.

- Provide mentorship and escalation support for junior team members to foster professional growth and resolve operational challenges.

Qualifications 

- Fluency in French and professional-level English is required given the scope of work and the client teams.

- Over 2 years of experience in end-to-end experience optimisation or CRO, including defining, launching, and evaluating A/B and Multivariate Testing (MVT) Campaigns using A/B testing platforms or website optimisation tools.

- The ability to analyse user behaviour and map customer journeys from initial discovery to final measurement, ideally within the luxury, beauty or fashion industries.

- Proficiency in web, app and product analytics combined with qualitative research tools (heatmapping, form analytics, live user testing) to uncover user behaviour insights.

- Analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable findings, recommendations, and optimisation roadmaps.

- You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business.

- When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English. 

Additional Information 

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

title: AI Unity Tools Engineer
description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world's best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we've raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who've built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The opportunity

As an AI Unity Tools Engineer, you'll build the next generation of QA automation and development tooling for Homa's games. This is a new, high-impact initiative, and you'll own it: from the first question to the tools running in production across our portfolio.

You’ll work across AI, Unity, QA automation, DevOps, and infrastructure to make testing and build pipelines more reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient for games developed by Homa and its studios. You'll be working on AI-driven QA automation at the edge of what is technically possible, and you'll see the impact directly in the speed, reliability, and cost of how our games are made.

What you'll do

- Build. Design and deploy AI-enabled QA automation pipelines across Homa's major Unity games.
- Run. Maintain and improve our TeamCity build pipelines and infrastructure so game builds stay reliable.
- Scale. Onboard new games and tools onto the platform without reducing service quality.
- Explore. Test AI-driven approaches to QA that cut manual testing effort and reduce reliance on costly legacy tooling.
- Drive adoption. Work with developers, QA teams, studios, and mobile teams so the tools you build are actually used.
- Measure. Track the impact of your work on testing time, build reliability, and cost, and turn it into clear recommendations.
Requirements 

- Ownership. You drive outcomes. When a build breaks or a test fails, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
- Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
- Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship. You turn ambitious ideas into practical, achievable solutions.
- Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly. You can explain a complex technical solution to developers, QA teams, and studios in a few sentences.
- AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink at least one thing you're proud of.
- Hungry and motivated. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You see this role as a chance to build something new and grow faster than anywhere else, and you're ready to work for it.
- Bonus: you've built something. An internal tool, a testing framework, a game, a side project. We'd love to hear about it.
For this role, you'll also bring

- Hands-on experience with Unity and the ability to understand Unity games, game systems, and testing contexts.
- Proven experience using AI systems, models, or AI-enabled engineering workflows in practice.
- Strong DevOps understanding, including TeamCity, build pipelines, and infrastructure.
- The ability to work across technical topics while understanding the wider product and business context.
- Experience working in a complex environment with meaningful product and testing volumes.
Bonus points if you have:

- Experience building QA automation or testing frameworks.
- Experience with AI-driven exploratory testing.
- Experience in gaming or another Unity-based product environment.
- Experience supporting products with high testing volumes.
- Experience driving adoption of internal tools across multiple teams.
Even if you don't check every box, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Why Homa

- Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
- Real ownership, early. This is a new initiative. Your tools will change how Homa and its studios build and test games, and you'll see the results.
- A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.
- AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works.
Benefits 

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:

- 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you'll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
- 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
- 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
- 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.

- 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we'll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.
Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we've designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cosy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

title: Senior Optical Systems Engineer
description:
About Quandela: 

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. 
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 

About this position: 

You will join the QPU Prototyping team , which develops and integrates the optical systems at the heart of Quandela's quantum processors, turning advanced R&D experiments into operational hardware. 

We are looking for a Senior Optical Systems Engineer to take ownership of a major optical development work package within our next-generation QPU programme. 

Your main challenge will be to maximise optical transmission and system performance , from experimental characterisation and precision alignment to qualification and integration. You'll tackle complex optical challenges, defining the right experimental approaches and driving solutions from investigation to validation. 

You will also coordinate technical activities involving several engineers and scientists, ensuring the delivery of critical milestones. 

This is a predominantly hands-on experimental role , combining deep technical expertise with project ownership.

Requirements 

What you'll do: 

Develop and optimise optical systems 

- Design, assemble, align and operate complex optical setups. 
- Characterise optical transmission, identify losses and improve efficiency. 
- Define measurement methods and improve stability and reproducibility. 
- Troubleshoot experimental challenges and implement reliable solutions. 
Qualify and integrate optical subsystems 

- Optimise research-developed optical subsystems for QPU integration. 
- Define experimental tests, performance targets and qualification procedures. 
- Collaborate with optics, electronics and system integration teams. 
Drive technical delivery 

- Own technical deliverables within a major optical development project. 
- Coordinate experimental activities across engineers and scientists. 
- Plan tasks, milestones, equipment and laboratory resources. 
- Anticipate technical risks, resolve blockers and guide contributors. 
The role combines approximately 80% hands-on experimental work and 20% technical coordination , with no initial requirement for formal people management. 
-

How you'll grow: 

First 3 months: Become familiar with Quandela's optical systems, experimental infrastructure and qualification objectives. 

Within 6 months: Take ownership of optical characterisation and optimisation activities, coordinating experimental work and technical milestones. 

Within 12 months: Lead the technical delivery of complex optical developments, with increasing autonomy over planning and resources. 

Longer term : Potential progression towards technical team leadership as the team grows. 

-

Requirements 

What we're looking for: 

We are looking for an experienced optical engineer or experimental scientist with strong hands-on expertise and the ability to drive complex technical projects. 

Relevant backgrounds include fibered optical systems, laser systems, experimental optics, and optical metrology. Academic and industrial experience are equally welcome. 

Must-have: 

- PhD in Optics, Photonics, Physics or related fields. 
- >5 years of experimental experience , including postdoctoral research. 
- Hands-on expertise in complex optical systems, alignment and troubleshooting. 
- Strong knowledge of linear optics, optical transmission and precision metrology. 
- Proven ability to optimise optical performance and solve experimental challenges. 
- Experience organising technical work and delivering project milestones. 
- Experimental rigour, teamwork and professional English. French is not required. 
Important, but you can grow here: 

Technical & system integration 

- Optical subsystem qualification and hardware integration. 
- Python for experimental automation and data analysis. 
- Semiconductor optics and quantum optical systems. 
Project & operational ownership 

- Experimental planning, equipment and resource management. 
- Coordination of multidisciplinary technical activities. 
Bonus: 

- Experience transferring R&D setups into operational systems. 
- Industrial qualification and reliability standards. 
- Experience mentoring engineers or researchers. 
- Exposure to quantum computing or advanced photonic hardware. 
Quantum computing experience is not required . What matters is your ability to understand complex optical systems, solve experimental challenges and deliver results. 

Benefits 

Benefits 

Join a multidisciplinary team developing the optical systems for next-generation quantum processors, with substantial experimental ownership and opportunities for technical progression. 

- Competitive compensation aligned with experience. 
- Company savings plan and profit-sharing. 
- 100% health coverage through Alan. 
- Transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus. 
- Swile meal vouchers. 
- Gymlib and childcare support. 
- Referral programme. 
Process 

- Talent Acquisition interview (30–45 min) 
- Hiring Manager interview (45–60 min) 
- Technical discussion on previous experimental work 
- Technical case study or presentation with the team 
- Reference checks 
- Team meeting 
- Offer 
Beyond that: 

At Quandela, we value diverse scientific and engineering backgrounds, practical curiosity and the ability to learn from different fields. 

Whether your experience comes from an academic laboratory, industrial R&D or a different area of experimental optics, we'd love to hear from you if you enjoy tackling demanding technical challenges and turning experimental work into reliable results.

title: IT Operations Lead - Banking
description:
EggAI · Banking transformation programme (UK) · Remote, UK-facing — London for gate weeks

About the Programme

EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production.

EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers.

The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems.

The Role

Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what "ready to run in production" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold.

The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. Agentic AI workloads need a different operating model, and you will shape it: redraw responsibilities between the client's teams and its managed service providers, set the standards each party works to, and lead the people through the change — so that those who run the platform today are ready and willing to run what comes next.

This is a lead/principal position reporting to the Programme Plan and Execution Lead. It is remote, with regular London presence required for gate weeks and workshops.

Responsibilities

- Reliability targets — set the SLO and error-budget framework alongside the client's existing structure, have the service owners adopt it, and commission the behavioural quality measures that do the same job for agentic workloads

- Observability and detection — define what Tier-1 services and agentic workloads must emit, including trajectory logging; require an automated path from a firing alert to the affected services and their owners; and hold the operating teams to closing the logging gaps in what runs today

- The incident and change path — set the runbook standard and its required coverage, extend incident classification and intervention mechanisms to agentic failure modes, and have rollback and change-failure rates measured and reported by those who own them

- Capacity and performance — direct the headroom position through the parallel-run peak at cutover, sponsor the chaos and game-day programme for payment rails and the core ledger, and mandate that capacity modelling covers inference workloads

- Gate evidence — own the technical content of the Operational Acceptance Report and Operational Readiness Certificate, the reliability section of each gate pack, and the reliability NFRs defended as ADRs through the client's Architecture Design Authority — written by the teams, reviewed and signed off by you

- The operating organisation — decide how responsibilities sit between the client's teams and its managed service providers for the new platform, and lead the people concerned through that change

Expected experience

- 10+ years in leading IT operations teams — You have operated L1, L2, and L3 support as SRE, platform reliability or infrastructure organisations, with the people and the providers reporting to you

- Aligns operations with development, engineering and the business — has set operating goals that engineering teams and business stakeholders signed up to, and kept them focused on those goals through delivery

- Has introduced SLOs and error budgets into an organisation that did not have them, and can build on the experienced success factors

- Infrastructure in depth — has deep infrastructure knowledge, and what is required for smooth business operations: telemetry, redundancies, backups, etc.

- Incident management , with post-incident reviews that led to real changes in the system and in the organisation

- Regulated financial services , or another environment where an external body audits operational evidence.

- Has worked through a managed service provider and can set standards they do not personally execute

- Comfortable operating in a complex, multi-stakeholder programme where scope and ownership are still being established across parallel workstreams

Valuable, not required 

- LLM or agentic system operations: eval harnesses, drift detection, trajectory analysis, prompt and model versioning treated as change types

- Core banking or payments exposure, particularly scheme gateway integration

What This Role Is Not

- Not a platform architect. A separate role owns agentic platform design and build

- Not an on-call engineer. You will not carry a client pager; out-of-hours operations are run by a third party

- Not a service delivery manager. This is engineering judgement applied to readiness, not ITSM process administration

title: Legal Counsel
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role 

You are BLP's first in-house lawyer. You build the legal function from scratch and protect a business that puts agentic AI into the ERP processes of 550+ enterprise customers. You report to the CFO and partner closely with Sales, Finance, People and Product, covering four entities in Switzerland, Germany, the UK and the US, with customers in 40+ countries. In your first 12 months, Sales runs on your contract playbook and standard templates, and BLP has a clear compliance framework for data protection and AI regulation.

What you'll do 

· Own commercial contracting end-to-end: negotiate customer MSAs, DPAs and SLAs with enterprise procurement and legal teams, so deals close faster with risk you can explain to the CFO.

· Build the legal toolkit: templates, a negotiation playbook with fallback positions and clear approval rules, so Sales can handle standard deals without escalating to you.

· Lead data protection and AI compliance across GDPR, the Swiss FADP and the EU AI Act, and support security reviews and certifications, so enterprise customers trust how we handle their data.

· Run corporate housekeeping for BLP Digital AG and its subsidiaries in Germany, the UK and the US: board and shareholder matters and cap table

· Advise on employment law across our countries and protect our IP and trademarks, working with the People team on contracts, policies and equity plans.

· Select and manage external counsel, deciding what stays in-house and what goes out.

What you'll bring 

· You bring 7+ years of legal experience, including at least 3 years in-house at a B2B SaaS or tech company, ideally after training at a leading law firm.

· You are admitted to the bar in Switzerland or another European jurisdiction and are comfortable advising on Swiss, EU, UK and US matters with appropriate external support.

· You have personally negotiated enterprise SaaS contracts with large corporate customers and closed them on terms the business could live with.

· You have hands-on GDPR and data protection experience and follow the EU AI Act closely.

· You have built something from zero before: a template library, a contract process or a legal function, and you are happy to be the only lawyer in the room.

· You are pragmatic and commercial in your approach. You give clear, risk-weighted advice in plain language, at the speed of a fast-growing company, in fluent English and German language.

Strong plus 

· Experience with venture financing rounds, ESOP setups and/or M&A.

· Background in ERP, finance automation or AI products.

· Experience with ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits from the legal side.

What you'll get 

· Founding ownership. You shape BLP's legal function from day one and decide how it scales.

· Direct line to leadership. You report directly to the CFO and work with the leadership team on decisions that matter.

· Global scope. Four entities, 40+ countries and enterprise customers give you breadth few in-house roles offer.

· You work at the front line of AI regulation, applied to real enterprise processes.

· You grow with the company and are set up to build and lead a team as legal needs expand.

· You work from our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, with a team that values Impact, Transparency, Ownership and Excellence.

· Competitive package.

title: Strategic Account Executive (Zurich)
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW 

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Strategic Account Executive to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business within your territory, focusing on building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across various personas within an account. You will play a crucial role in expanding our customer base and ensuring successful sales outcomes through effective pipeline generation and accurate sales forecasting.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Pipeline Generation: Creating 80% of your pipeline by identifying new business opportunities and engaging with multiple personas within the prospect/customer base. Utilize various strategies and tools to generate leads and move them through the sales cycle.

- Sales Forecasting: Develop and maintain accurate sales forecasts (+/- 10 of goal), leveraging data to inform decision-making and ensure predictable revenue outcomes with the goal of consistent attainment of revenue targets.

- Solution Selling: Effectively communicate the value of our platform, tailoring presentations and proposals to meet the specific needs of each prospect.

- Negotiation and Closing: Lead negotiations with potential clients, by thoughtfully addressing key stakeholders including multiple personas and CxO in the buyer journey, while navigating organizational complexities, addressing objections and securing new business agreements.

- Account Management: Work across multiple personas within an account to understand their unique needs and align Benchling’s solutions with their business objectives.

- Collaboration: Partner with internal teams (marketing, product, customer success, etc) and Channel to ensure a seamless experience for clients and drive long-term customer satisfaction.

- Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to maintain a competitive edge in the market.

- Process: Drive the sales process through Pipeline Generation (PG), 3 Why’s, Champion Building, MEDDICC, Command of the Message, etc. Maintain account integrity and opportunity data within company systems; Salesforce.

QUALIFICATIONS 

You are drawn to our mission and you want to help Benchling win new business. You are committed to working in a collaborative environment, working together as a team. You have a love for working in a fast-paced environment and taking the initiative to get stuff done and try new things. You are passionate about powering new possibilities in biotech faster.

- Proven experience as an Account Executive, preferably within a data management, workflow SaaS or technology-driven environment that sells to multiple personas across IT & Line of business.

- Demonstrated ability to drive pipeline generation and manage complex sales cycles.

- Strong sales forecasting skills with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.

- Demonstrated success in selling products or solutions that typically fall outside of pre-established budgets, with a proven ability to build a compelling business case and influence purchasing decisions.

- Experience working with diverse personas within an account (from technical decision makers, business decision makers & CxO execs), with the ability to influence decision-making at all the levels.

- Dynamic communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

- Self-motivated, with a strong drive to achieve and exceed goals.

- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.

- Familiarity with MEDDICC sales methodology is a plus but not required.

- Knowledge of the life sciences industry, including: R&D, and/or IT functions is preferred but not required.

- Bachelor’s degree - life sciences major is preferred but not required.

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

title: Senior Specialist, QA
description:
About Summit: 

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) 

- 
HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

- 
HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

- 
HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC) 

- 
HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland. 

Overview of Role: 

The Senior Specialist, QA will provide operational leadership and quality oversight for the review, approval and release-readiness of clinical and commercial product batches. 

The role is responsible for ensuring that batch documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with applicable GMP requirements, approved procedures and regulatory commitments before submission to QA for final disposition or QP certification. The person will coordinate batch-release activities across Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and external manufacturing partners, ensuring that issues are identified, escalated and resolved in a timely manner. The position will also lead process improvements, support inspection readiness and promote high standards of data integrity and Good Documentation Practice across the batch-release process. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Batch Review and Release Readiness 

- Coordinate the end-to-end QA review of executed batch manufacturing, packaging, testing and release documentation for IMP and Commercial biological batch records. 

- Coordinate the preparation and collation of batch documentation required for final batch disposition or QP certification from internal and external sources. 

- Verify that batch records are complete, accurate, and compliant with approved procedures, specifications and applicable GMP requirements. 

- Confirm that relevant deviations, investigations, change controls, CAPAs, and laboratory results have been appropriately assessed and approved before release. 

- Identify documentation gaps, discrepancies and potential compliance risks, and coordinate their timely resolution. 

- Maintain oversight of batch-release priorities, review status, outstanding actions, and planned release dates. 

- Escalate critical issues or potential delays to Quality leadership and relevant stakeholders. 

- Ensure that batch-release documentation is appropriately archived and readily retrievable electronically. 

- Quality Systems and Compliance: 

- Ensure batch-release activities are performed in accordance with current GMP, Good Documentation Practice, data-integrity principles, and internal procedures. 

- Support the effective operation of quality systems associated with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, and training. 

- Review and approve relevant quality documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, checklists, and batch-release procedures. 

- Maintain controlled documentation and ensure that current approved versions are available to relevant personnel. 

- Support periodic reviews of procedures and identify opportunities to strengthen compliance and operational effectiveness. 

- Promote the appropriate use of electronic quality and document management systems. 

- Act as a subject-matter expert for batch documentation, release-readiness and associated document-control processes for all batch release activities. 

- Internal Team Coordination (EU QA) 

- Provide day-to-day leadership and technical guidance to QA batch reviewers and supporting personnel. 

- Plan and allocate batch-review activities according to business priorities, product demand, and release timelines. 

- Monitor team workload, quality metrics, and completion of assigned activities. 

- Develop and deliver training in Good Documentation Practice, batch-record review and relevant quality-system processes. 

- Support onboarding and qualifications of new QA team members. 

- Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture within the QA function. 

- External Team Collaboration: 

- Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control / CMC, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Supply and other relevant functions to support timely batch release. 

- Coordinate with all Summit CMOs, testing laboratories and service providers to obtain missing documents and resolve release-related queries. 

- Communicate batch status, risks, priorities and outstanding actions clearly to internal and external stakeholders. 

- Support changes affecting batch documentation or release processes. 

- Participate in cross-functional meetings concerning batch disposition, documentation, readiness, and supply continuity internally. 

- Inspection Readiness and Continuous Improvement 

- Maintain batch-release processes and supporting records in a continuous state of inspection of readiness. 

- Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, internal audits, and supplier audits. 

- Retrieve and present batch documentation and quality-system records during audits and inspections. 

- Track batch-review metrics, recurring documentation issues, cycle times, and overdue actions. 

- Analyse trends and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, right-first-time performance and compliance. 

- Lead or contribute to Lean and process-optimization initiatives within the batch-release function. 

- Support the implementation and enhancement of electronic quality, document management and reporting systems. 

Qualifications and Experience 

- Essential 

- Recognized qualification in Quality, Pharmaceutical Science, Life Sciences, Engineering or related discipline. 

- Significant experience in Quality Assurance within a pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or similarly regulated manufacturing environment – preferably in Biologic manufacturing, Packaging and Labelling environments. 

- Practical experience reviewing executed batch records and supporting batch disposition or QP certification activities. 

- Knowledge of GMP, Good Documentation Practice, and data-integrity requirements. 

- Experience working with deviations, investigations, CAPAs, and change controls. 

- Experience using electronic quality, document management and other enterprise-systems - systems such as MasterControl, NetSuite, Veeva Vault, TrackWise, SAP or equivalent platforms. 

- Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple priorities and deliver against critical release timelines. 

- Experience supporting the release of medicinal products or investigational medicinal products. 

- Experience working with contract manufacturing organizations and external testing laboratories 

- Key Competencies 

- Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy 

- Sound quality and compliance judgement 

- Leadership and team coordination 

- Effective prioritization and workload management 

- Problem-solving and risk-based decision-making 

- Clear communication and stakeholder management 

- Audit and inspection readiness 

- Data integrity and information governance 

- Process improvement and operational efficiency 

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment 

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
80-100% | as soon as possible | Germany or Switzerland 

About Exeon 

Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation. 

What your impact will be like: 

As a Systems Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. 

You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success.

In particular, you will:

- Build tooling and automation to simplify the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Exeon.NDR, Exeon.UEBA, log collection and supporting components 

- Design, build, and maintain scalable log ingestion pipelines for a wide range of network and application log sources and formats, including parsing, normalization, and validation 

- Deploy and operate Exeon in customer environments (on-prem, private cloud, and hybrid), including sizing, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex issues 

- Work with customers to understand their data sources, infrastructure constraints, and security needs, and translate these into clear requirements for product and engineering teams 

- Contribute to customer support, documentation, and runbooks alongside your Solutions colleagues

What you can expect from us: 

Exeon offers an open company culture that values and encourages diversity, teamwork and a growth mindset. Our goal is to provide our employees with an exciting, supportive and motivating environment for personal growth and career development while ensuring that our team maintains a healthy work-life balance. We strive to achieve this by offering:

- An exciting and impactful job in a fast-growing Swiss cyber tech company expanding across Europe with manifold opportunities to shape your professional profile.

- Working in close collaboration with our interdisciplinary team and learning from our Security Experts, Data Scientists, and Business Professionals.

- Taking over responsibilities quickly and help shape and promote a cutting-edge security software.

- A high degree of trust, independence and flexibility, also in terms of working hours and place of work (remote or in the office).

- A competitive salary and appealing benefits package.

What you bring along: 

We are looking for a proactive, self-motivated and enthusiastic cyber security professional who is comfortable in a high-paced start-up environment and who shares our values. You should be confident with solving problems independently and communicating easily with both internal teams and directly with customers. You should also:

- 3-5 years of experience in systems engineering, data engineering, platform/infrastructure engineering, or a similar role 

- Working knowledge of network and application security and the telemetry relevant to detection 

- UNIX/Linux experience, including networking, troubleshooting, and performance tuning in containerized deployments (Docker and/or Kubernetes) 

- Strong programming skills in Python and Bash (or comparable languages), with a focus on automation and maintainable, production-quality code 

- Hands-on experience designing and operating data ingestion pipelines (e.g. syslog, Logstash/Fluentd/Vector, Elastic stack, or similar), including handling heterogeneous formats and high volumes 

- Comfortable with working in a largely remote team where clear communication is key to successful collaboration and impact. We are an English-speaking team but German fluency is appreciated when communicating to some customers 

- Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have:

- Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals, common attack patterns, and the log and telemetry sources that matter for detection 

- Experience with SIEM, SOAR, or detection platforms (e.g. Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic Security), or as a detection engineer or security analyst 

- Familiarity with network telemetry such as NetFlow/IPFIX, Zeek, or Suricata, and frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK 

- Prior customer-facing or professional services experience.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Building the intelligence behind Solskin

Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive?

We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow.

In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist.

What you will do

This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day.

Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better.

Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. 

Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. 

Our stack: 

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch

- Frontend: React, TypeScript

- Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs

- Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB)

- DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana

What we are looking for

Required: 

- Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar.

- Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems.

- Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. 

- Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems.

- Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS.

- Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader.

- Languages : English. German is a big plus.

- Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products.

- Availability : 100%, as soon as possible.

- Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position.

Preferred: 

- Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means.

- Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. 

- Frontend: React and TypeScript.

Mindset: 

- Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself.

- Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you.

- Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter.

Benefits

Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work.

Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company.

Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days.

Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out.

The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one.

Sounds like you?

Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Please cover these points:

- About you: A short description of yourself.

- Proud of: One thing you are really proud of, in a few sentences.

- Startup: Why do you fit a startup?

- Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together.

- Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it.
