title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

- Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

- Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

- Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 

- 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

- 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

- 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities 

1. Storytelling That Converts 

- Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

- Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

- Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

- Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution 

- Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

- Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

- Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA 

- Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

- Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

- Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

- Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops 

- Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties.

- Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments.

- Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth.

- Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments.

What We Are Looking For 

Essential Experience & Qualifications 

- 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines.

- Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality.

- Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts.

- Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools.

- Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably.

- CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho.

Preferred Technical Skills 

- Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations

Mindset & Soft Skills 

- Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture.

- Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning.

- Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment.

Working Environment & Expectations 

- Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast.

- Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win.

- Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively.

Why join Papers? 

- Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means.

- High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes.

- Influence the Growth strategy from day one.

- Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth.

- 25 days paid vacation per year.

- Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly).

- Support for your ongoing learning and development.r

title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to hardware, moving across the stack, and solving the kinds of problems where milliseconds, bandwidth, startup time, and system efficiency matter.

You will work across the AuterionOS ecosystem on topics such as:

- Embedded Linux performance and system tuning

- Low-latency video streaming and media pipelines

- C/C++, Python, and Bash-based platform development

- Hardware integration, system profiling, and end-to-end optimization

- Collaboration with experienced and driven engineers across Auterion

Responsibilities 

- Work within the Apps & Simulation team and collaborate with other development teams to build high-performance products for autonomous systems.

- Design, optimize, and maintain performance-critical components within AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.

- Improve end-to-end system behavior across compute, networking, video, and hardware interfaces, with a strong focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and resource efficiency.

- Analyze and optimize demanding workloads such as real-time telemetry, video streaming, media processing, and communication between distributed system components.

- Investigate system bottlenecks across the full stack, from kernel and OS behavior to application-level code and tooling.

- Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases, and translate them into robust technical solutions.

- Propose and implement new platform capabilities with a strong emphasis on measurable performance gains in real-world deployments.

- Participate in daily stand-ups, release planning, and prioritization discussions.

Qualifications and Skills 

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

- 5+ years of professional experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python.

- Deep experience with embedded Linux systems, including cross-compilation, debugging, profiling, and performance tuning.

- Strong hands-on background in diagnosing and optimizing real-world system behavior, including CPU, memory, I/O, networking, boot time, and application latency.

- Experience building or optimizing low-latency video or data-streaming pipelines, ideally on embedded platforms.

- Excellent understanding of software systems that span embedded devices, higher-level applications, and fully integrated products.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, implementation, debugging, and testing.

- Experience with video codecs, GStreamer, RTP/RTSP, or hardware-accelerated media pipelines.

- Solid experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Bash scripting, and systemd.

- Experience with Docker and docker-compose in complex development and deployment environments, as well as qemu.

- Strong debugging and performance analysis skills at both system and application level, combined with a proactive and self-directed working style.

- Proficient in ROS2/DDS-style middleware and experienced with networking across multiple OSI layers, including REST APIs and performance-sensitive communication paths.

- Experience with system integration and interfacing sensors or peripherals, especially via USB and Ethernet.

- Experience working in an agile engineering environment with stand-ups, sprint planning, and shared ownership across teams.

- Bonus: Experience with build systems such as CMake, including improving build performance in large-scale software projects.

Benefits 

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Company pension plan 

- Car parking 

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

- Mental health and wellbeing support

- Learning and development opportunities

About Auterion 

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Tools & Systems
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role: 
We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering. 

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems. 

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering. 

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership. 

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role. 

What you'll do: 

- Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering. 

- Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools. 

- Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency. 

- Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries. 

- Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions. 

- Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams. 

What you'll bring: 
Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below. 

- Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful. 

- Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform. 

- Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling. 

- Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions. 

- Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use. 

How you work: 

- You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state. 

- You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve. 

- You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns. 

- You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment. 

- You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas. 

What you’ll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 

- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage 

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together 

- Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday 

- One-time home office stipend 

- Annual professional development budget 

- Quarterly well-being stipend 

- Considerable paid parental leave 

- Employee referral bonus program 

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) 

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world’s most mission-critical ERP environments.

Key Responsibilities 

Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. 

The SAP "Triple Threat": 

- Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles.

- SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations.

- GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations.

C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity).

Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base.

Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP’s rigorous reporting standards.

Required Skills/Experience 

- Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner).

- Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) .

- Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees.

- Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP’s regional field teams.

- Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO.

- Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required.

- Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.

- Language: Professional fluency in English. Additional regional language skills are a strong plus (written and spoken).

Our offer: 

- You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, and an attractive salary.

- You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement.

- Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms.

- The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP.

- Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication.

About Onapsis 

Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications.

Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world’s leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies.

title: Projectontwikkelaar
description:
Ben jij een projectontwikkelaar met een passie voor vastgoed en gebiedsontwikkeling? Heb je al de nodige vlieguren gemaakt met complexe projecten en voel je je thuis in samenwerkingen met diverse partijen? Wil je zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken aan uitdagende projecten, van haalbaarheid tot realisatie? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Dit wordt jouw baan 

Als projectontwikkelaar leid je vastgoedprojecten van concept tot realisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, verkoop en het volledige procesmanagement. Van haalbaarheidsstudies tot de start van de bouw: jij houdt het overzicht. Je onderhoudt relaties met partners, beleggers, woningcorporaties en overheden en zorgt voor een vlotte samenwerking tussen alle betrokkenen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die bij gebiedsontwikkelingen bijdraagt aan het realiseren van impact op jouw (deel)project.

Dankzij je ervaring met complexe projecten (appartementen en binnenstedelijke ontwikkelingen) weet je snel te schakelen tussen belanghebbenden en bewaak je het totaalplaatje, inclusief conceptontwikkeling, duurzaamheid, budget en planning.

Wat ga je doen? 

- Markt & Klant: Analyseren van de marktvraag en het ontwikkelen van passende product-marktcombinaties. Opstellen van grond- en vastgoedexploitaties en coördineren van verkooptrajecten. Onderhouden en uitbouwen van relaties met beleggers en woningcorporaties.

- Locatie & RO: Begeleiden van RO-procedures en vergunningstrajecten.

- Organisatie: Coördineren van het ontwikkelings- en ontwerpproces, inclusief de financiële en commerciële aspecten.

- Tijd & Geld: Opstellen en bewaken van exploitaties en planningen, uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en voeren van onderhandelingen om de beste resultaten te behalen. Jij hebt als geen ander gevoel voor het sluiten van goede deals.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer 

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. 

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. 

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. 

Focus op vastgoed bij Dura Vermeer 

Dura Vermeer heeft grote ambities als ontwikkelaar. In onze portefeuille vind je uitdagende (gebieds)ontwikkelingen met onderscheidende concepten, veelal op binnenstedelijke locaties. Ons werkgebied beslaat Zuid-Holland, waar we de stedelijke uitdagingen omarmen en maximale waarde willen toevoegen in onze plannen. Dit resulteert in projecten waar je echt impact kunt maken op gebieden als stedenbouw, architectuur, duurzaamheid en sociale cohesie. 

Als organisatie groeien we naar een vestiging waar jaarlijks 800 woningen risicodragend worden geacquireerd en verkocht. Dit betekent dat we zelf het risico dragen van de aankoop tot verkoop van de woningen. Jij speelt een belangrijke rol in onze complexe ontwikkelingen. 

Dura Vermeer onderscheidt zich op het gebied van samenwerking. We werken nauw samen met gemeentes, partners en stakeholders binnen onze projecten, en zeker ook met onze collega’s in Rotterdam. We staan bekend om onze intensieve en oprechte samenwerking, die leidt tot innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen in elk project. 

Op nationaal niveau heeft Dura Vermeer een sterke vastgoedorganisatie waar je op kunt terugvallen. Regelmatig ontmoet je collega’s van andere vestigingen om kennis uit te wisselen en expertise te ontwikkelen. Met onze interne gebiedsstudio, ID, bieden we een expertisecentrum voor ruimtelijke ontwikkeling, marktadvies en verkoopmanagement, acquisitie en gebiedsontwikkeling, dat je ondersteunt bij jouw projectopgaven. 

Met recent gewonnen tenders zoals Sportcampus Rotterdam , WijCK Pijnacker en De Werf in Oegstgeest en de aankoop van het Hunter Douglas terrein in Rotterdam laten we zien dat we meedraaien op het hoogste niveau van gebiedsontwikkeling. 

Hier zit je op je plek 

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het ontwikkelen van gebieden en buurten en het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen. 

Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige teams, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams. 

Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken! 

Dit breng je mee 

- Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, in de richting Bouwkunde, Vastgoedkunde, Vastgoed en Makelaardij, Technische Bedrijfskunde of Real Estate Studies; 

- Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar;

- Minimaal 5 jaar recente, relevante werkervaring als ontwikkelaar en/of projectontwikkelaar binnen de woningbouw (appartementen). 

- Ruime ervaring in het ontwikkelen van projectlocaties in de provincie Zuid-Holland, waarbij jij ook een sterk netwerk hebt opgebouwd in deze provincie; 

- Als persoon denk je out-of-the-box, kom je met nieuwe initiatieven en neem je de verantwoordelijkheid om duurzaam te ontwikkelen. 

- Je bent op technisch en commercieel vlak creatief ingesteld en communicatief zeer vaardig. Door jouw enthousiasme en duidelijke manier van communiceren weet jij mensen te adviseren en te overtuigen; 

- Tot slot ben jij leergierig, ambitieus en ondernemend. 

Dit bieden wij jou 

- Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij een medior profiel tussen € 5.639,- en € 7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur) en bij een senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. 

- Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten. 

- Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra).

- Met oog op een langdurige relatie bieden we je na 2 maanden proeftijd een onbepaalde tijd contract.

- 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

- Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card.

- Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit.

- Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland.

- Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

title: Stagiair(e) Energie en Leefomgeving
description:
31-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,– stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master | 6-12 maanden 

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot 

De energietransitie is in volle gang. Overheden en bedrijven werken toe naar het behalen van Europese en landelijke doelstellingen, maar dit is vaak makkelijker gezegd dan gedaan. Om beleid tot uitvoering te brengen, moeten uiteenlopende belangen, overtuigingen en visies bijeenkomen. De grenzen tussen beleid en uitvoering zijn daarbij soms vaag. Op dat snijvlak werken wij: wat is de beste strategie om de doelen te behalen, en hoe werken we daar samen naartoe? Daar heb je kennis van de energietransitie voor nodig, maar ook gevoel voor mensen, context en organisaties. Dit is uitdagend, complex en leuk! 

Wil jij meewerken aan de meest urgente energie- en klimaatvraagstukken van Nederland? Wil jij met frisse ideeën en nieuwe inzichten bijdragen aan oplossingen voor uiteenlopende organisaties? En ben je benieuwd naar het werk bij een adviesbureau? Berenschot biedt jou de kans om tijdens een stage actief mee te werken aan deze complexe en actuele uitdagingen! De startdatum van je stage is 1 oktober 2026 (in overleg). 

Dit ga je doen 

Als stagiair(e) werk je onder andere mee aan opdrachten die gaan over energiesystemen, netcongestie, de warmtetransitie, betaalbaarheid en systeemweerbaarheid, op landelijk, regionaal én lokaal niveau. Opdrachtgevers zijn overheden (ministeries, provincies, gemeenten), netbeheerders, energiebedrijven, uitvoeringsorganisaties en woningbouwcorporaties. Daarbij werken we niet alleen voor, maar vooral ook mét onze opdrachtgevers. 

Een aantal voorbeelden van opdrachten waaraan wij werk(t)en: 

- Het uitdenken en opbouwen van grote nationale uitvoeringsprogramma’s van het Klimaatakkoord, zoals het Nationaal Programma RES, het Nationaal Programma Lokale Warmtetransitie, het Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem, en programma’s rondom hernieuwbare opwek (zon op dak, wind op land, etc.). 

- Het begeleiden van (grote) gemeenten bij het ontwikkelen van een warmte(net)strategie. 

- Het ondersteunen van netbeheerders en provincies bij de ontwikkeling en programmering van het energiesysteem van de toekomst (Energievisies) en het verminderen van netcongestie. 

- Overheden helpen met het opstellen van effectief klimaatbeleid met behulp van prognoses op basis van onze eigen Regionale CO2-routekaart. 

- Het uitvoeren van volumeprojecties voor waterstofdragers richting 2035, om inzicht te krijgen in de verschillende stromen en knelpunten. 

- Het ontwikkelen van een alternatief nettariefstelsel voor netbeheerders, waarmee de netbelasting wordt gespreid en netcongestie wordt beperkt. 

- Overheden helpen met het opstellen en uitvoeren van beleid en plannen om de energietransitie rechtvaardiger te maken (bijvoorbeeld door bestrijding van energiearmoede, de inzet van fix-teams, het sturen op isolatie, etc.) 

Tijdens jouw stage krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan adviesopdrachten en lever je een bijdrage aan interne projecten, zoals bijvoorbeeld evenementen. Welke adviesopdrachten je doet, bepalen we samen met jou (afhankelijk van jouw interesses, achtergrond en kennis, en welke opdrachten er lopen). 

Quote 

“De variatie aan projecten, klanten en collega’s zorgt ervoor dat je snel een beeld krijgt van wat je doet als consultant. Je werkt als stagiair(e) écht mee aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten!” 

Hier kom je terecht 

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. 

Dit zijn je directe collega’s 

Je gaat aan de slag binnen de adviesgroep Energie en leefomgeving in het Expertisecentrum Energie & Strategie (ECES). We zijn een club jonge, enthousiaste en ambitieuze professionals die sterk gemotiveerd zijn om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je collega’s hebben bijvoorbeeld (technische) bestuurskunde gestudeerd, of bedrijfskunde, planologie, energy and environmental sciences, milieustudies, of politicologie. 

Dit neem je mee 

Berenschot is een verzameling van persoonlijkheden en achtergronden. We kijken dus vooral of je goed in het team past. We zoeken in elk geval een flinke dosis energie en enthousiasme, gecombineerd met nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om jezelf op inhoud en adviesvaardigheden te ontwikkelen. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar net zo goed samen. Verder heb je: 

- een sterk analytisch vermogen en uitstekende sociale vaardigheden 

- sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en kun je helder en gestructureerd rapporteren 

- duidelijke interesse in en affiniteit met de energietransitie en verduurzamingsvraagstukken 

- de intrinsieke drive om maatschappelijke impact te maken. 

Dit bieden we jou 

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en creëren volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. 

Daarnaast bieden we: 

- een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltimebasis) 

- een laptop 

- flexibele (thuis)werkmogelijkheden 

- persoonlijke begeleiding door een ervaren adviseur 

- een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng 

- de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en onze relaties 

- de mogelijkheid om in te stromen in een Berenschot-traineeship. 

Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling. Afstuderen bij ons is een optie, de mogelijkheden van een scriptie bespreken we graag samen verder met je. 

Solliciteer meteen 

Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Solliciteer direct! Stuur je cv en motivatie naar Vicky Schats. Neem bij vragen gerust contact op met Vicky Schats via WhatsApp (06 25 72 26 12) of per e-mail ( ). 

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Rob Lindner beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier. Neem contact op met Rob via .

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description:
As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life.

You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment.

You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product.

Key Responsibilities:

- Develop and realize robust, manufacturable mechanical and structural solutions for the OptiArray system throughout the product development lifecycle.

- Translate product and system requirements into mechanical designs suitable for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation.

- Design and integrate structural components, interfaces, mounting features, lifting arrangements, and corrosion protection solutions into the overall product.

- Produce engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, interface documentation, and design records.

- Perform structural engineering analyses and testing, including lifting loads, fatigue, hydrodynamic behavior, environmental loads, and mechanical robustness.

- Develop and evaluate prototypes and engineering models to validate structural performance and manufacturability.

- Drive design improvements focused on manufacturability, assembly, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle performance.

- Support product integration, verification, qualification, FAT, and industrialization activities, resolving mechanical and structural issues where required.

- Perform engineering trade-offs considering structural integrity, weight, cost, manufacturability, corrosion resistance, offshore installation, and lifecycle performance.

- Work closely with fabrication suppliers, offshore contractors, and technical partners to ensure designs can be successfully manufactured, deployed, and operated.

- Identify technical risks, investigate root causes, and implement effective design improvements and mitigation measures.

- Provide technical guidance within the marine structures domain and collaborate across engineering disciplines to support sound technical decisions and successful product delivery.

Why Join Us? 

- Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

- Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

- Fresh team lunches provided 5 times / week.

Qualifications: 

- BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Naval Architecture, or related engineering discipline.

- Minimum 5 years of experience developing offshore, marine, mechanical, or structural systems.

- Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

- Experience designing marine products, offshore equipment, or subsea mechanical systems.

- Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design.

- Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners.

- Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams.

- Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance.

Preferred 

- Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design.

- Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings.

- Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects.

- Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management.

Screening 

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

title: City Launcher, Groningen
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company . You might enjoy our YouTube Channel , Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage , or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like .

About the role 

Over the last few years, Monumental has gone from developing a product that works and delivering our first pilots to building at scale - a fleet of 150+ robots that have laid bricks for 90+ homes, a school, a community centre, a hotel, and 150+ m of canal walls.

We're taking on more construction projects - "deployments" - every month, with more robots, more people, and now in new markets as we scale from the Netherlands into the UK and US.

As Hub Lead, you’ll stand up our first hub outside HQ, in the north of the Netherlands. You’ll start by running our largest deployment to date, then build the team and operations around it as the project pipeline ramps up behind you. 

We're hiring versatile operators who want to run a deployment as if it were their own business. Behind every one of these projects is a Deployment Manager who owns it end to end. In practice this is five jobs in one: site foreman, operations manager, account executive, analyst, and project manager. You make the build plan, deploy yourself with your team on site as a subcontractor, manage the contractor relationship, and take responsibility for delivering quality walls, finished on time - in construction, one of the most chaotic industries there is. Your goal will be to run multiple deployments in parallel, overseeing complex and high stakes projects.

One day you're up at dawn, travelling to site, cutting bricks, running the schedule, working with the general contractor and watching your build plan go up brick by brick. The next you'll be at our facility analysing your deployment's P&L and building the systems that improve your margin on the next deployment. You’ll own delivery and translating friction you observe on-site to our R&D team.

This is hard, on-site operations, and some of the most rewarding work you'll find. Robots break, weather turns, the contractor changes the plan, and it's on you to keep the build moving.
You'll have an extraordinary amount of autonomy. It's an excellent fit if you've founded a company before, or if you're looking for an entrepreneurial role where you can make outsized impact.

What you’ll do 

- Plan the logistics of a deployment: decide how many and which robots and humans to send, coordinate with other subcontractors, and make both a day-to-day operational plan while also thinking about the bigger picture and how your decisions impact our unit economics.

- Spend time on the construction site, overseeing, managing, and motivating the team; liaising with the general contractors and other stakeholders; and generally representing the company and selling our story. You’re comfortable speaking with the guys building scaffolds, the CEOs of the biggest general contractors, and our engineers, all on the same day.

- Build the operational systems that make each deployment run better than the last - spotting inefficiencies, fixing processes, improving margin

- Work with our existing customer base and drive growth of new construction projects and, in the future, adjacent product lines beyond bricklaying.

- Own the P&L of your deployment and propose ways to continuously improve our unit economics.

- Support hiring and interviewing additional robot and deployment operators.

What we’re looking for 

- Minimum of 3 years of experience in management as a startup founder, GM, in operations, strategy, business development or a similar area.

- Given the local nature of the construction industry, this role requires you to be a native Dutch speaker.

- You generally need to be an excellent communicator and be comfortable speaking with a broad range of personas.

- You don’t mind getting your hands (literally) dirty to get the job done.

- A strong bias-to-action and getting-shit-done mentality with the required tenacity and speed. The emphasis of this role is execution, not analysis.

- You’re comfortable in a high-stress environment. Things constantly go wrong at construction sites, the stakes are high, and we’re introducing new technology with novel failure modes.

- Raw intellectual horsepower and eagerness to learn. We expect this role to have a steep learning curve whatever your background, and this role might in practice feel like a completely new job every 3-6 months. You’ll learn a lot about construction, robotics, and being part of a high-growth, hard-tech company.

- Experience and ability to manage, lead, and motivate a (small) team.

- Strong operational and analytical skills. You can build a spreadsheet with a clear operational plan, or present a P&L and model various scenarios and drivers. You’re a strong project manager.

Why Monumental? 

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.

For open applications (where you don’t see an exact role match), please reach out to us at: ----- - share with us the most interesting or challenging project you’ve worked on, why you want to join and your CV or portfolio.

Unfortunately we do not currently support internships.

If you don’t meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you’d still be able to help us solve difficult problems, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

- Excellent communication skills and experience mentoring engineers and bringing teams along when tools or ways of working change.

Nice to have

- Migrating a monolith from VMs to Kubernetes

- Managed databases and search in production (MySQL/PlanetScale, PostgreSQL, MongoDB Atlas, Elasticsearch)

- Multi-account AWS, Kafka, Cloudflare or AI/LLM workloads in production

- A background in security, compliance (e.g. GDPR) or incident response

⚙️ Our tech & AI mindset 

AI is not a buzzword at Trengo. It is part of how we build and operate. You’ll work with AI-driven features, automation, data, or tools that help us move faster and smarter. We value thoughtful use of AI that creates real value for customers and teams.

What’s in it for you? 

We believe in supporting you to perform at your best and grow with us:

- 🚀 A key role where you’ll make a visible impact in a vibrant scale-up environment.

- 🌍 Hybrid working + 60 days per year to work abroad.

We aim to keep the process clear, fair, and timely, and we’ll keep you informed at every step.

Join us in building the future of customer engagement — we’d love to have you on the team.

👉 Apply today and let’s grow together!

title: Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician
description:
About Us 

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 

As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards.

This is a hands-on execution role . You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager , who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). You take your daily and weekly priorities from the Assembly Tech Lead , who sets the assembly schedule and is the technical authority on the floor; fridge loading is planned in close coordination with the measurement team.

What you'll be doing 

Core Responsibilities 

- Assemble quantum chips into their packaging , working from technical drawings and work instructions to place and mount the chip in its housing and mount the chip in its housing with the PCB.

- Make the electrical connections , wirebonding (manual and automatic) will be a significant part of the daily activities, as well as manual soldering.

- Measure and test your work , performing the defined electrical and mechanical checks and recording the results, so issues are caught before a device moves on.

- Finish and close the package , including sealing, inspection, laser engraving and preparing for transportation to the measurement location.

- Load our cryogenic fridges with new chips to be measured , mounting packaged samples and QPUs, making the wiring, thermal and mechanical connections, and closing up the system with magnetic shields. 

- Safeguard quality , handling fragile, high-value parts with care and following handling and ESD procedures, because a single scratch, particle or ESD event can ruin a chip.

Supporting Responsibilities 

- Flag deviations early , stopping and raising it with the Assembly Tech Lead when something does not match the instruction or does not look right, rather than improvising a fix.

- Help improve how we work , giving practical feedback on work instructions, fixtures and tools while our processes are still maturing.

- Keep a safe, clean and organised workplace , applying 5S and HSE rules every day and making sure your bench, tooling and consumables are ready.

Your Profile 

- MBO-level technical education (level 3 or 4) or equivalent, for example in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electronics, fine-mechanical or precision engineering, or lab or instrument technology.

- 4+ years of hands-on experience assembling mechanical, electrical or mechatronic systems; relevant internships count.

- Able to read work instructions with photos and technical drawings, and comfortable with basic digital tools and production systems.

- Good with your hands at two scales: precision in assembly, handling of fine devices and connectors, and mechanical assembly such as bolting, cabling and fitting larger parts together.

- Precise and patient, with a genuine liking for detailed hands-on work done well, every time, and a practical approach to solving problems.

- Comfortable with structured, repeatable work, and disciplined about following instructions step by step and recording what you did.

- Comfortable in an environment that is still being built, where not every process is finished yet and priorities can shift.

- A team player in a young, driven team who communicates openly and speaks up when something isn't right.

- Good command of technical English.

Bonus if you also bring:

- Experience with wirebonding, die attach or other chip-packaging / microelectronics assembly.

- Experience with measurements, diagnostics or troubleshooting.

- Experience in a lab, ESD-controlled or 5S production environment.

- Experience assembling, servicing or setting up complex equipment, instruments or machines.

- Familiarity with cryogenics or vacuum systems.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer: 

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare 

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. 

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Technisch Support Engineer

Wat ga je doen? 

Als Technical Support Engineer ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor technische vragen over onze warmtepompen. Je combineert technisch inzicht met klantcontact en werkt nauw samen met onze service-, product- en engineeringteams.

Wat breng je mee? 

We zoeken iemand die technisch nieuwsgierig is, graag problemen oplost en energie krijgt van het helpen van anderen. Je hoeft nog geen expert in warmtepompen te zijn. We leren je graag hoe onze systemen werken.

title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale 

Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role 

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan . You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now 

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do 

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

- Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

- Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

- Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem

Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

- Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

- Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

- Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

- Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

- Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

- Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't 

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

- It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

- It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

- It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for 

- 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

- A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

- Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

- Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

- A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

- Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

- You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions. 

About TheyDo 

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make. 

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’ , never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘ Simply to accelerate ', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process. 

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner. 

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

title: Senior Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join Trust & Safety’s Actioning team, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The team owns critical mechanisms, including user reporting, moderation workflows, policy enforcement, and interventions against malicious users.

You will leverage your expertise in machine learning to research, design and implement new models for report and appeals prioritization, advanced sanctioning based on users' suspicions, and automation of moderation decisions. This involves working closely with our engineering teams to develop robust pipelines for data handling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and continuous improvement. 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will utilize advanced machine learning techniques to analyze text, images, and other data formats, tackling complex challenges to identify and address content that poses potential risks. You will champion best practices and methodologies, significantly enhancing the team's effectiveness and safeguarding Vinted. You will mentor others, influence the strategic direction for model development, and facilitate cross-functional collaborations to drive impactful results.

In this position, you’ll 

- Lead the research, development, and end-to-end lifecycle of production machine learning models that prioritize and automate actions on harmful marketplace entities at scale.

- Play a crucial role in establishing and refining essential machine learning processes, such as data versioning, creating labeling pipelines, and ensuring high-quality data availability for effective model training.

- Actively collaborate across teams, particularly with Data Infrastructure and backend engineers, to develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and scalability of deployed models.

- Influence and contribute to the strategic roadmap for the Actioning team, collaborating with Decision Scientists to test, assess, and continuously improve new models.

About you 

- Proven track record in data science (4+ years of experience), with a strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, or computational mathematics.

- Proficiency in both classical and deep learning techniques, and an adeptness in leveraging the latest tools and methodologies to solve complex problems.

- Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI applications or LLM-powered workflows that handle large traffic, balancing quality, latency, and cost efficiency.

- Deep understanding of the challenges involved in deploying, maintaining, and scaling real-time ML models in production, with a proven ability to address these challenges effectively.

- Proven capability to work with engineering teams, designing and implementing efficient data ingestion, feature engineering, and model training pipelines that support robust and reliable model deployment.

- Excellent problem-solving abilities, with a commitment to staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning and data science, driving innovation and thought leadership within the team.

- Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring that technical elements are properly understood and integrated to deliver business value.

- Past experience with fraud detection, harmful content detection or any other adversarial domain would be considered an advantage. 

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 25 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Frequent team-building events

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per working day

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan

- NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport

- Company bike leasing scheme

- Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform

- Work from Home allowance

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

SEO Strategy & Optimization

- Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns .
- Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
- Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
- Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
- Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.

What a Typical Day Looks Like 

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Overview 

We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices , and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities 

- Application Modernization Execution: Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.

- AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling: Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.

- Consultative Engineering & Change Management: Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.

- Hands-on Software Development: Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.

- Feedback Loop: Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.

- Standards & Quality: Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.

Required Qualifications & Experience 

- Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.

- Full Stack Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java).

- Cloud Native & IaC: Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform.

- Consulting & Change Management: Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams.

- DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices.

- Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

- Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

Preferred Skills (A Plus) 

- Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization.

- Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies.

- Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar.

- Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment.

- Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda).
