title: Agentic AI Principal
description:
We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.

Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.

The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.

Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.

Job responsibilities

Shaping and winning 

- Agentic AI advisory and strategy: shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.

- Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.

- Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.

- Lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentisation, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.

- Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.

Designing and building 

- Design and build engineering: set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.

- Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.

- Ensure agents run on trustworthy data foundations, working with data engineering and data product teams on data quality, semantics and access.

- Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.

- Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.

- Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.

- Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Governance and safeguards 

- Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.

- Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.

- Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.

- Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.

Principal-level leadership and growing capability 

- Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.

- Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.

- Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.

- Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.

- Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.

- Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.

- Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).

- Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.

- Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.

- Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).

- Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.

- Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.

- Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.

- Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.

- Strongly preferred: delivering AI in healthcare or life sciences (e.g. R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing quality, commercial). 

- Nice to have: integrating agents with SAP and industrial or manufacturing systems; data product and data platform foundations for AI.

Consulting and Commercial Track Record

- Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.

- Strong consulting and commercial judgement: you can point to data and AI (ideally agentic or GenAI) pursuits you helped shape, sell and deliver in the last three to five years, from around €3M–5M upwards, including fixed-price or outcome-linked elements.

- Experience shaping, solutioning, selling and delivering complex deals of €5M+ in the last few years. Annual target of solutioning, selling and delivering €10M+ TCV in Data & AI deals with an AI-first delivery focus.

- Comfortable discussing P&L, business cases and ROI with executive buyers, not just architecture.

- Consultancy or professional-services experience within the last five years, ideally with German, Dutch or DACH enterprise clients.

- You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset (e.g. a reusable accelerator).

Professional Skills

- Executive presence and communication skills, making complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, moving fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.

- Ability to influence across organisations without formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.

- Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and raise standards across a wider engineering community.

- Self-directed, prioritisation-led working style, with creative problem-solving in fixed-scope, outcome-driven work.

- Experience navigating German and Dutch stakeholder structures, including works councils, data protection officers and procurement.

- German B2 minimum , C1 strongly preferred; fluent English. Dutch is a plus for Netherlands-based candidates.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment .

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

- Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.

- Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.

- Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.

- Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

- A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.

- Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.

- Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

- Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.

title: IT Cloud Administrator (f/m/d)
description:
About Munich Electrification 

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership : We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability : We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture : We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit : We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Your Role: 

Your primary mission is to own and evolve our Digital Ecosystem , ensuring our cloud-first infrastructure is as innovative and high-performing as our battery technology. You will ensure that our core platforms ( Google Workspace and the Atlassian ) function as a seamless, interconnected network that empowers our company. Acting as the vital bridge between business requirements and technical execution, you will master the configuration of existing solutions and be the technical lead for new application/service implementations.

Key Responsibilities: 

- SaaS & Cloud Governance : Act as the Platform Owner for Google Workspace and Atlassian , managing configurations, security, and permissions.

- Business Process Evolution : Work with department heads to translate business needs into scalable digital workflows.

- Vendor & Stakeholder Contact : Coordinate with external consultants and developers.

- Documentation & Training : Maintain high-quality documentation of our application landscape and lead training sessions for power users.

Your Profile: 

- Education : Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.

- Experience : Min. 3-5 years of experience as a Full-time Cloud/IT Administrator . Proven track record in Application Management, specifically with MDM systems and Cloud/SaaS environments.

- Technical Expertise: Good knowledge of Atlassian and Google Workspace administration.

- Analytical Mindset : You enjoy mapping complex business processes into clean, digital solutions.

- Communication : Fluent in English; German is a plus; Ability to explain technical concepts to non-IT stakeholders.

Optional: 

- Experience with AWS .

- Experience with Google Cloud Identity & SSO integrations.

- Certification in ITIL

- SAP Knowledge : Practical experience with SAP (ByDesign or S/4HANA).

Our Offer & Benefits 

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees): 

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

- Pension Plan/Bonus

- Free access to the fitness center right next to us or subsidized EGYM Wellpass

- Free snacks, coffee, drinks and lunch (freshly cooked by our chef) every day

- Public transport ticket

- Bike-Leasing via Business Bike

- Experience various inspiring and fun team events

- ME-branded clothing

- Option to "work from anywhere" (6 weeks/year)

title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
description:
We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.

The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces. 

How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?

About Nelly 

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will: 

- Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

- Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany

- Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start

- Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do

- Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs

What you'll bring: 

- Agency. You go after the problems that matter most, including well beyond your immediate scope, rather than waiting for a roadmap to land on your desk

- Comfort in a high-velocity environment. You move fast, make bold but reversible calls, and challenge early and directly, including upward

- Business-outcome orientation. You're genuinely data-driven: you can name the metric each project moves and let evidence, not gut feel, drive prioritisation

- Technical fluency. You reason confidently about APIs, data models, data flows and how systems fit together, and you're a credible partner to senior engineers

- You build with AI. You use AI to move faster: prototyping to pressure-test an idea, taking a first pass on the analysis or the spec yourself, shipping the small things directly, so your time goes to judgment and the decisions that move the product

- 7+ years of product management experience

Even better if you have: 

- Built and shipped AI products

- Worked on data platforms or data products

- Built B2B SaaS in healthcare or another regulated industry

- Professional German language knowledge

Our Interview Process: 

- Introduction to Nelly with TA

- Product craft interview with our Product manager

- Case study interview with Director of Product

- Onsite interview with hiring manager and stakeholders

What we offer: 

- The people you get to work with. You will work alongside the brightest minds we could find, on hard problems, as a team. We take on challenges together and we never forget to have fun doing it.

- Room to grow faster than almost anywhere else. New challenges, more scope, real ownership from day one. We trust you to own it and to speak up when something is wrong. Just do not expect to stand still.

- A yearly learning and development budget , plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning. 

- A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact.

- Deutschlandticket or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast.

- Urban Sports Club membership , for sport and balance.

- Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup. 

- Up to 4 weeks of workation. 

- A dog friendly office with great vibes and a team that is fun to work with.

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen, reibungslosem WEG-Tagesgeschäft und lokalen Teams, die mit der Buena-Software spürbar besser arbeiten als vorher.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
About Andercore 

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

title: Growth Consultant | Deutsch C2
description:
Growth Consultant (m/w/d), Account Management für 30 bis 40 B2B Tech Kunden in Berlin

Die meisten Account-Management-Jobs heißen Beratung und bestehen am Ende aus Reporting-Decks und Ticket-Pingpong. Hier ist es umgekehrt: Die Umsetzung macht das Team, du berätst.

Unser Kunde ist eine AI-first GTM Agentur aus Berlin Mitte. Seit 2024 auf über 5 Mio. EUR ARR und 30+ Leute gewachsen, mit 200+ B2B Tech Kunden, von der Mobility-App über einen Schweizer Telko-Konzern bis zum Bildungsverlag. Zuletzt kam in einem einzigen Monat über 1 Mio. EUR neuer ARR dazu.

Jeder dieser Kunden braucht jemanden, der ihn hält und ausbaut. Genau dafür ist dieser Seat da.

Das Paket: 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention, Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage Office und 2 Tage remote.

Tasks

- Du führst dein eigenes Portfolio aus ca. 30 bis 40 Accounts und sitzt alle zwei Wochen mit Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern im Termin.

- Deine Kunden sind B2B Software- und Tech-Firmen, die über Google, LinkedIn, Meta und signalbasiertes Outbound ihre Pipeline aufbauen. Insgesamt laufen jeden Monat sechsstellige Budgets in Paid Search und Paid Social über die Agentur.

- Der typische Moment: Ein Geschäftsführer, der viel Geld in Ads und Outbound steckt, fragt dich, warum seine Leads teurer geworden sind und ob er das Budget kürzen soll. Du hast die Antwort und den nächsten Schritt.

- Beratung statt Operatives: Kampagnen bauen die GTM- und Performance-Marketing-Teams. Du entscheidest mit dem Kunden, was als Nächstes gebaut wird.

- Upsell und Retention sind dein Hebel: neuer Kanal, mehr Budget, Verlängerung. Dein Spielfeld ist das bestehende Portfolio.

- Du liest die Zahlen deiner Accounts (Leads, Cost per Lead, Pipeline) und siehst ein Abwanderungsrisiko, bevor der Kunde es ausspricht.

Requirements

- Ein paar Jahre B2B mit echter, eigener Kundenverantwortung. Ob als Account Manager, BDM, kommerzielles Customer Success, AE mit Bestandskunden oder Founder’s Associate, der Titel ist egal. Interne Koordination oder reines Projektmanagement zählt hier nicht.

- Du erzählst deinen Track Record in Zahlen: wie viele Accounts, welche Retention, wie viel Upsell-Volumen.

- Wenn dir ein Geschäftsführer im Call sagt, die Leads taugen nichts und er überlegt zu kündigen, gehst du in die Daten statt in die Defensive und kommst mit einem Plan raus.

- Du hältst 30+ Kunden parallel auf dem Schirm, ohne dass einer durchrutscht, und baust dir dafür dein eigenes System.

- Du brauchst niemanden, der dir den Tag plant. Du siehst die Lücke und schließt sie.

- Idealerweise hast du Outbound, Lead Gen oder B2B-Akquise schon selbst gemacht. Pluspunkte: Google oder LinkedIn Ads, CRM, Agentur-, Consulting- oder Startup-Background.

- Fix: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, gutes Englisch, Festanstellung in Vollzeit, 3 Tage pro Woche im Berliner Office (der erste Monat komplett vor Ort).

- Early Career bis Mid. Gesucht ist Hunger, nicht Seniorität: Wer seit Jahren Senior Advisory macht, wird hier nicht glücklich. Ein Abschluss oder ein großes Logo im Lebenslauf sind nicht das Tor, deine Zahlen schon.

Benefits

- 50 bis 70k EUR Fix plus 12,5% Provision auf Upsell und Retention. Du verdienst also auch daran, dass Kunden bleiben, nicht nur an neuen Deals. 

- Perspektive: Die Agentur sucht explizit Leute, die Experten- oder Führungsverantwortung übernehmen wollen. 

- Lernkurve: Alle zwei Wochen sitzt du mit Geschäftsführern aus 30 bis 40 verschiedenen B2B Tech Firmen am Tisch. Nach 12 Monaten kannst du einem GF sagen, welcher Kanal sich für sein Geschäftsmodell rechnet und welcher nicht.

- 1:1 Coaching mit erfahrenen Leuten ab Tag 1.

- Office in Berlin Mitte, 3 Tage vor Ort und 2 remote, MacBook und eigener Platz mit Bildschirm.

- Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club M, regelmäßige Team-Abende.

- Start: ASAP

Closing

Klingt nach dir? Die Bewerbung dauert zwei Minuten, kein Motivationsschreiben.

So läuft’s: Bewerbung ➝ Talent Call mit uns ➝ 10 Min Kennenlernen beim Kunden ➝ 30 bis 45 Min Deep Dive ➝ ca. 90 Min vor Ort mit den Gründern und dem Team ➝ Rückmeldung innerhalb von 2 Tagen.

Warum über GENZ4GTM: Vor jedem Kundengespräch bekommst du von uns ein Cheatsheet, nach jeder Runde ehrliches Feedback, und mit einer Bewerbung matchen wir dich auf mehrere passende Rollen.

title: Robotics Engineer - Integration & Control (m/f/d)
description:
About Prefiro

Asparagus cost up to 25 euros per kilo this season! That’s because, like most of the produce on the shelf, it’s harvested exclusively by hand. Here at Prefiro, we’re the first to automate these processes! We use artificial intelligence, and robotics to bring next-generation agricultural equipment to the field.

Are you excited about applying new technologies in real-world conditions, solving interesting and varied problems, and seeing firsthand the impact your ideas have?

Then join our growing team and help us deliver the first autonomous asparagus harvester to farms.

Your responsibilities

- Integrate robots and IO into the robotics stack – from startup and service to error handling and recovery.

- Work on MPC-based trajectory planning and optimal control: from approach to implementation on the robot in real time.

- Help optimize cycle times in real-world applications

- Scale the stack from one robot module to several per machine: networking, robot setup and calibration.

- Tune the robot computers for real-time control: Docker, CPU pinning, ROS 2 scheduling and multithreading.

- Build remote access, data collection and robotics CI/CD (e.g. rosbag-playback tests) to improve the robots with real field data.

- Review code, contribute to architecture decisions and debug the stack as a team.

- Run the robots during pre-season field tests and the harvest season.

What you bring

- Master's Degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.

- At least 2 years of professional experience in robotics, including hands-on work with real robots (not only simulation).

- Strong modern C++ (C++17) and Python 3.

- Hands-on experience with ROS 2 (ideally Jazzy): nodes, lifecycle nodes, executors, QoS, launch files.

- Experience with trajectory controllers and trajectory planning.

- Solid grounding in robot kinematics and dynamics (URDF, Pinocchio or similar).

- Proven experience with optimal control and model predictive control for trajectory planning; reinforcement learning is a plus.

- Comfortable with CMake/colcon builds and Git on Linux.

- Experience with real-time robot control and an understanding of soft real-time constraints on Linux (scheduling, latency, threading).

- Fluent English , our working language.

Nice to have

- Industrial arms, especially Denso SCARA (b-CAP, RC8) or Universal Robots.

- Optimal-control frameworks such as acados or CasADi; control barrier functions.

- MoveIt 2 or Ruckig for motion planning.

- Docker, GitLab CI and automated testing (GoogleTest, launch_testing).

- DDS or Zenoh tuning and multi-robot setups.

- Debugging tools such as RViz, Foxglove, PlotJuggler or Nsight Systems.

- Field deployment with systemd, tmux and shell scripting.

- Basic German.

What we offer

- Real fields from your first season. Your code runs on our machines on farms in Germany.

- Short way from code to robot. New ideas usually run on the real machine within a few days.

- A problem worth solving. Green asparagus is still harvested entirely by hand.

- A small, motivated team that gets a lot done together. When you join, we're 8 full-time, plus 2 interns and a working student.

- Open culture, flat hierarchies. We are still early, so your opinion counts in technical decisions.

- Lunch and coffee together in the kitchen in our hall.

- Employee stock options. 

How to apply

Send your CV and a few lines on a robotics project you built on real hardware (links to code welcome) via the "Apply now" button. Please include your earliest start date, salary expectations and vegetable you want to automate next.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Stream Processing)
description:
About Nebius: 

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the event-processing pipelines and services that turn Nebius product usage into revenue.
You will work on systems that process a continuous stream of usage events, where correctness and failure recovery matter as much as throughput. The output is money: a silently dropped or double-counted event is a real financial error.
Usage of every Nebius product arrives as a stream of events. Our pipelines and services ingest, validate, enrich and price it in near real time, and deliver the results to invoicing, reporting and customer-facing account management.

In this role, you will:

- Build stateful streaming pipelines that compute billed consumption in near real time.

- Develop and operate Go services that ingest usage events, move data between our storage systems and deliver consumption data to users through usage APIs and billing data exports.

- Guarantee correctness under failures: idempotency, exactly-once processing and reconciliation.

- Operate transactional storage, persistent queues and change data capture under high throughput.

- Build reusable streaming infrastructure rather than solving each use case independently.

- Improve the reliability, scalability, latency and observability of the billing platform.

- Take end-to-end ownership of your systems: design, implementation, reliability and deployment.

We expect you to have:

- Strong software engineering fundamentals.

- Professional experience building and operating backend, streaming or data-intensive systems.

- The ability to reason about consistency and data correctness under failures.

- Experience with databases, messaging systems or event-processing platforms.

- The ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and solve problems without an obvious predefined solution.

- The ability and willingness to learn the team's technology stack.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

- Experience with a stateful stream-processing framework such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams.

- Experience designing streaming pipelines.

- Go development experience.

- Experience operating services in Kubernetes.

Technology stack

- Go, Python

- Apache Flink

- YDB

- YTsaurus

- Messaging and event-streaming systems

- Kubernetes

title: Senior Returns Manager, EU
description:
ABOUT QUINCE 

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE 

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

- Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 

- Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Returns Manager to own end-to-end reverse logistics performance across our UK and EU operations. From forecasting incoming volume through grading, refunds, fraud prevention, and resale, you'll build a returns operation that's fast, accurate, and cost-efficient — while turning returned inventory back into recovered value. This is a hands-on role for someone who can dig into root causes, manage partners and carriers, and build the reporting to prove it's working.

What You'll Do

Returns Forecasting & Planning 

- Build and maintain returns volume forecasting models across UK and EU markets, factoring in seasonality, backlog, promotions, and category-level return patterns

- Translate forecasts into staffing, processing capacity, and warehouse space plans for returns operations

- Monitor returns rate trends and flag volume shifts to inventory, finance, and merchandising teams

Customer Refunds 

- Oversee timely, accurate refund processing in line with UK and EU consumer rights regulations

- Audit warehouse/QRC staff on grading standards and quality checks

- Partner with customer service and finance to resolve refund discrepancies and disputes

- Track refund turnaround time against SLA and resolve bottlenecks in the refund workflow

Fraud Detection & Prevention 

- Build and refine fraud detection processes for returns abuse (wardrobing, serial returners, empty-box claims, item-not-as-described fraud)

- Partner with risk and customer service teams to develop fraud rules/flags and investigate high-risk cases

- Balance fraud prevention with customer experience, avoiding over-blocking of legitimate returns

Returns Root Cause & Logistics Feedback 

- Track and categorize return reasons, with particular focus on logistics-driven returns (damaged in transit, wrong item shipped, late or failed delivery, packaging failure)

- Partner with warehouse, supply chain, and carrier teams to reduce logistics-driven returns through root cause analysis and corrective action

- Present return reason trends to leadership to inform packaging, product, and logistics improvements

Returns Resale & Recommerce 

- Manage resale/recommerce channels for graded inventory (open-box, refurbished, clearance, secondary market and liquidation partners)

- Maximize recovery value on returned inventory while minimizing time-to-resale

- Build and manage relationships with resale/liquidation partners and evaluate new recommerce channels across UK and EU markets

Reverse Logistics & Carrier Management 

- Negotiate rates and service levels with carriers for return shipments across UK and EU markets

- Manage carrier performance for return pickups, label generation, and inbound transit times

- Evaluate and roll out returns-specific shipping options (paperless returns, drop-off points, pickup services) to reduce cost and improve the customer experience

SLA & Performance Management 

- Define and manage SLAs across the returns lifecycle — receipt to grading, grading to disposition, refund turnaround, and time-to-resale

- Monitor 3PL and warehouse partner performance against returns SLAs; escalate and resolve issues as needed

- Build reporting and dashboards to track returns KPIs and turn data into actionable recommendations for leadership

Cross-Functional & Compliance 

- Partner with customer service, supply chain, finance, and merchandising to align returns operations with broader business goals

- Ensure returns operations comply with UK and EU consumer protection, distance selling, and VAT/duty rules (including treatment of re-imported goods and refund-related VAT adjustments)

- Stay current on evolving returns-related regulation across UK and EU markets

What You'll Bring

Required 

- 5–8+ years managing returns or reverse logistics operations in a high-volume ecommerce or retail environment, ideally across UK and EU markets

- Experience building returns forecasting and capacity planning models

- Solid understanding of UK and EU consumer rights, refund, and distance-selling regulations

- Experience designing or managing returns fraud detection and prevention programs

- Track record reducing logistics-driven returns through root cause analysis and cross-functional fixes

- Experience managing return resale, refurbishment, or liquidation channels

- Carrier negotiation experience for reverse logistics/return shipping

- Strong SLA and KPI management skills, with reporting experience (Excel, SQL, or BI tools)

- Hands-on experience with WMS/OMS returns modules

- Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills

Preferred 

- Experience in DTC, fashion/apparel, or other high-return-rate ecommerce categories

- Familiarity with recommerce or liquidation platforms and partners

- Experience operating across multiple EU countries and languages

- Background in fraud/risk analytics

- Experience managing reverse logistics SLAs with UK/EU carriers (e.g., Royal Mail, Evri, DPD, DHL, GLS)

WHY QUINCE? 

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY 

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form . We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds 

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. title: Data Scientist (Measurement & Signal Processing) (f/m/d)
description:
Description 

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements.

We are looking for a Data Scientist to own one question for the team: can we trust this map, and if not, where in the chain did it go wrong? Every measurement, in our lab or at a customer, gets a verdict and a reason. You build the checks that produce it, keep the catalogue of known artifacts and reference measurements behind it, and make it automatic for the routine cases so that your judgement goes to the hard ones. When a check fails, you trace it to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not. Our Applications engineers, who run the customer projects, rely on your verdict for what reaches the customer. A senior data scientist on the team backs you on the hard calls at the start; the aim is that you become the owner of this question.

This is a hands-on analysis role, not a research position: the data is real, the chain is in daily use, and every improvement you make shows up in the next measurement. Your background does not need to be in quantum sensing or semiconductors: if you have learned to tell signal from noise, calibration errors and artifacts in another demanding measurement system, we want to hear from you.

Who we are 

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds? 

Picture this: 

- Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

- Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

- Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

- An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us? 

- You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

- From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

- Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

- You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible! 

What will you do 

- Build the checks, from raw quantum sensor signal to field map, that tell a trustworthy measurement from a measurement or reconstruction artifact, on lab and customer data alike.

- Trace a failed check to its source in the chain, fix it when it sits in the evaluation, and drive the fix with the owning engineer when it does not.

- Keep the catalogue of known artifacts and the set of reference measurements that make every new verdict faster and more defensible.

- Validate the team's evaluation methods against simulation and reference measurements before they go into daily use.

- Give our Applications Engineers and the team a clear verdict on each measurement, and feed what breaks back into the next generation of the QDm.

What is expected of you 

- 3+ years of professional experience outside academia applying data science to measurement or imaging data from physical instruments.

- A degree in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics or a related discipline; a PhD is welcome, not required.

- Solid statistics and signal or image processing: you ask where a signal comes from, tell it from noise and systematics, and show it with numbers.

- Fluency in Python and the scientific stack, with version control and tests as a habit.

- AI coding agents are part of how you work, and you check their output the way you check your own.

description:
Description 

QuantumDiamonds is building commercial quantum sensing tools for semiconductor inspection and failure analysis. As our Quantum Sensing Engineer (NV Centers) , you will join the Hardware Pre-Development Team and take technical ownership of the sensing core of our widefield Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDM).

At the heart of your role is one question: how do we get more performance out of the NV sensing system?

title: Finance Manager (w/d/m)
description:
Finance Manager (m/w/d)

Berlin · Vor Ort · Unbefristet · So bald wie möglich

About 

LIFTED is a strength training company from Berlin. We operate several studios across the city and are opening in Munich, Hamburg, Cologne, and Düsseldorf next. We’re set to become the largest fitness company in Europe. The founding team has built and scaled a fitness company before, and we run this one owner-led, with decisions made quickly and close to the work. If that sounds like your kind of place, we’d like to meet you.

Über die Rolle 

Du wirst die erste Person bei LIFTED, die sich voll um Finance kümmert. Bisher macht das Carl, Co-Founder und Geschäftsführer, neben allem anderen. Ab jetzt baust du den Bereich mit ihm auf.

Heute haben wir sechs Studios, bis Ende 2027 werden es rund 20, in mehreren Städten. Jede Eröffnung bringt einen Business Case, ein Budget, eine Finanzierung und neue Zahlen im Monatsabschluss. Weil du direkt mit Carl arbeitest, siehst du all das aus erster Hand.

Du startest im Tagesgeschäft: Zahlungsverkehr, Monatsabschluss, Liquidität, Planung. Sobald das sauber läuft, übernimmst du mehr, bis hin zu FP&A, Business Cases für neue Studios und Finanzierung.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Steuerbüro, unserem Admin-Team, dem Expansion-Team und den City Managern zusammen.

Aufgaben

Finance Operations 
Du verantwortest den Zahlungsverkehr inklusive Gehaltslauf, Leasing und Kautionen. Die Vorkontierung macht unser Admin-Team nach klaren Regeln. Du kennst die Logik dahinter, prüfst Stichproben, klärst neue Fälle und entwickelst die Regeln in Moss weiter.

Monatsabschluss & Reporting 
Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss mit unserem Steuerbüro vor, grenzt Umsätze von Partnern wie Urban Sports Club und Trainerkosten ab und prüfst die BWA. Daraus erstellst du in Helu ein monatliches Reporting pro Studio und gleichst Plan und Ist ab.

Planung & Liquidität 
Du pflegst unsere Planung, die nach BWA-Konten und Kostenstellen aufgebaut ist, und hältst sie bei neuen Studios und Änderungen aktuell. Du planst die Liquidität rollierend und bereitest die Unterlagen für Banken und Partner vor.

HR-Administration 
Vorerst kümmerst du dich auch um Personalstammdaten, Arbeitsverträge und die Vorbereitung der Payroll.

Was du Schritt für Schritt übernimmst 
Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du FP&A: Budget, Forecast und Szenarien, etwa wenn sich bei einem neuen Studio Miete oder Eröffnungstermin ändern. Du rechnest Business Cases für neue Standorte, bevor wir unterschreiben. Du bereitest Finanzierungsgespräche vor und führst sie zunehmend mit.

Qualifikation

- Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, VWL, Finance oder einem ähnlichen Fach.

- Berufserfahrung: 2–4 Jahre in Finance, idealerweise in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.

- Antrieb: Du willst schneller lernen, als es dein bisheriger Job zulässt, und übernimmst Verantwortung, bevor dich jemand darum bittet.

- Setup: Du kennst das Zusammenspiel aus vorbereitender Buchhaltung, externem Steuerbüro und DATEV und hast schon mit SKR03 oder SKR04 gearbeitet.

- Tools: Du arbeitest sicher in Excel. Erfahrung mit Moss, Helu oder ähnlichen Tools ist ein Plus.

- Hands-on: Du packst operative Themen selbst an und baust Abläufe so, dass sie ohne dich laufen.

- Business-Interesse: Du willst verstehen, warum eine Zahl so ist, wie sie ist.

- Sprachen: Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C2) und sicher Englisch.

- Standort: Du lebst in Berlin (oder bist bereit umzuziehen).

Benefits

- Direkt mit den Foundern: Du reportest direkt an Carl und bist seine rechte Hand bei allen Finance-Themen, mit voller Transparenz über die Zahlen. Du bekommst so viel Verantwortung, wie du übernehmen kannst, und wie weit das geht, liegt an dir.

- Steile Lernkurve: Du lernst alle Bereiche von Finance kennen, vom Zahlungsverkehr über FP&A bis zur Finanzierung.

- Coaching: Du lernst von einem Gründerteam, das schon einmal ein Fitnessunternehmen aufgebaut hat, und direkt von Carl. Wir setzen auf dich, fordern dich und helfen dir, schnell besser zu werden.

- Solides Fundament: Ein profitables Geschäft, das schnell wächst.

- Berlin HQ: Unser Büro im Prenzlauer Berg (Senefelder Platz).

- Becoming Stronger: Eine kostenlose, unbegrenzte Mitgliedschaft für alle LIFTED Studios.

- Team Spirit: Regelmäßige Teamevents wie Padel, BBQs und Trainer-Partys.

Wir schätzen deine Zeit. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen CV und eine kurze Notiz (3–5 Sätze) zu dem, worauf du in deiner bisherigen Finance-Arbeit am meisten stolz bist.

Du hast die ersten Jahre in Finance hinter dir und Lust, jetzt richtig was zu reißen? Dann bewirb dich.

title: (Senior) AI Engineer (w/d/m)
description:
Du verantwortest AI-Systeme für den Mittelstand, vom ersten Termin bei Kund:innen bis zum laufenden Betrieb. WE BUILD AI gibt es seit Februar 2025. Wir sind rund zehn Leute in einem Loftbüro in Köln-Ehrenfeld und bauen AI-Lösungen für den gehobenen Mittelstand.

- Level: Regular oder Senior

- Ort: Köln-Ehrenfeld und Homeoffice

- Start: ab sofort

Bei uns gehört dir ein Projekt

Du arbeitest immer in einem Projektteam mit anderen Engineers und Consultants. Gemeinsam klärt ihr mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung unserer Kund:innen, was sie brauchen. Die Architektur verantwortest du, und das System bauen und betreiben wir zusammen.

So läuft ein Projekt bei uns

Ein typisches Projekt hat drei Phasen, und du begleitest alle als technisch verantwortliche Person im Projektteam.

- Discovery Sprint mit dem Fachbereich: Wir legen fest, welches Problem wir lösen und woran wir den Erfolg messen.

- Pilotphase mit klaren Go/No-Go-Kriterien: Ihr baut eine erste Version, die Nutzer:innen im Fachbereich testen.

- Ausbau und Betrieb: Trägt der Pilot, bringt ihr das System in den Alltag und haltet es mit Monitoring stabil.

Deine Aufgaben

Bei aktuellen Projekten dreht es sich viel um das Training von eigenen VLMs und um das, was jedes Unternehmen umtreibt: den Einsatz von Agentic AI im gesamten Unternehmenskosmos.

- Du konzipierst LLM-Anwendungen mit RAG, strukturierter Extraktion und Agentic Workflows und entscheidest die Architektur.

- Backend-Services und APIs entwickelst du in Python, meist mit FastAPI.

- Auf Azure, meist mit Azure OpenAI und AI Foundry, bringst du die Systeme in Betrieb und betreust sie dort.

- Mit Tests, Evaluation und Monitoring sicherst du die Qualität von Anfang an.

- Gemeinsam mit unseren Consultants klärst du Anforderungen mit Fachbereich und IT-Leitung der Kund:innen.

Dein Profil

- Du hast mindestens eine LLM-Anwendung oder ein ML-Modell selbst in Betrieb gebracht, die Menschen im Arbeitsalltag nutzen.

- Python beherrschst du sicher, inklusive Tests und Deployment.

- Erfahrung mit einer Cloud-Plattform bringst du mit, am liebsten Azure, alternativ AWS oder GCP.

- Deine technischen Entscheidungen kannst du begründen, auch gegenüber Kund:innen.

- Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Feld, alternativ vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weil der Kundenkontakt auf Deutsch läuft.

- Klassisches Machine Learning ist ein Plus.

Was wir dir bieten

- Den Aufbau eines Unternehmens begleiten und eine neue Generation von Beratung und Engineering prägen

- Benefit-Budget von 30 Euro im Monat für Gutscheine bei über 100 Anbietern, Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket

- Dienstrad-Leasing per Gehaltsumwandlung mit bis zu 40 Prozent Ersparnis, Vollkasko und Wartung inklusive

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice nach eigener Verantwortung

- Mentoring, Peer Reviews und regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche mit ehrlichem Feedback

- Gemeinsame Workations und regelmäßige Teamevents

- Loftbüro in Köln-Ehrenfeld mit Bürohunden, Getränken, Snacks und Mario Kart

Ehrlich vorab

Wir sind ein kleines Team ohne eigenes Plattform-Team, und viele technische Entscheidungen triffst du selbst. Wer lieber in einem großen Team an einem eigenen Produkt arbeitet, ist woanders vermutlich glücklicher.

Bewirb dich bei uns

Das ist der Ablauf unseres Bewerbungsverfahrens:

- Gemeinsamer Call, etwa 30 Minuten. Wir sprechen über dich und über uns.

- Probeaufgabe mit etwa 2 Stunden Aufwand. Danach stellst du deine Lösung in 45 bis 60 Minuten vor.

- Treffen in Köln mit gemeinsamem Essen, Einblick in laufende Projekte und fachlichem Sparring im Team.

Nach jedem Schritt hörst du innerhalb von einem Werktag von uns. Von der Bewerbung bis zum Angebot planen wir drei Wochen.

Neudata is the global leader in alternative and market data intelligence, helping investors, hedge funds and corporates discover, evaluate, and use data to make smarter decisions. title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”? 

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents . We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job 

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

- Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

- Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

- Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

- Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

- Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

- Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it 

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have 

- 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

- A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

- Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

- Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs)

- A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again

Allow us to introduce ourselves 

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀 

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process , and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here 

Your mission as an Analytics Engineer 

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong data engineering skills to join our Data team and help build a scalable, reliable, and well-structured data foundation across Appinio.
In this role, you will design and maintain clean, scalable data models that make data easy to access, understand, and use across the organisation. You will use SQL, dbt, and Python to transform raw data into meaningful datasets, develop automated workflows, and ensure consistency and reliability across our data warehouse.
Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure.
Working closely with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and business teams, you will help define and standardise key business metrics such as revenue, bookings, and churn, ensuring a single source of truth across the company. You will also take ownership of data quality through automated testing, validation, and monitoring across the data lifecycle.
You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. You will also help prepare our data foundation for AI-driven analytics by ensuring that data models, business definitions, and documentation are structured, consistent, and accessible.
You will contribute to documentation, performance optimisation, and the continuous improvement of our data stack, helping us build a robust and scalable data platform that enables teams across Appinio to make faster, more informed decisions.

What you’ll be doing 

- Data Modeling: Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models in the data warehouse using SQL and dbt, making data accessible and reliable for analysts and business users.

- Data Transformation: Develop and maintain data transformation workflows, turning raw data from multiple sources into structured, analytics-ready datasets.

- Data Quality & Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by implementing automated tests, validations, monitoring, and proactive issue resolution across data pipelines and models.

- Documentation: Document data models, pipelines, business definitions, and transformation logic to ensure transparency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing.

- Business Logic Ownership: Define, implement, and standardize key business metrics (e.g. revenue, bookings, churn) to ensure consistency across reporting and analytics.

- Collaboration: Work closely with analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.

- Performance & Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize SQL queries, dbt models, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and efficient use of data warehouse resources.

You will thrive in this role if 

- Strong SQL & Data Modeling Skills: You have excellent SQL skills and hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data models in a modern data warehouse.

- Experience with dbt: You have practical experience using dbt to develop, test, document, and maintain reliable data transformation workflows.

- Data Engineering & Python: You are proficient in Python and have experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines, including integrations with APIs, databases, and third-party systems.

- Data Warehousing Knowledge: You understand modern data warehouse architectures and have experience working with cloud-based solutions such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.

- Data Quality & Reliability: You have a strong understanding of data quality principles, automated testing, validation, and monitoring, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.

- Business Understanding: You can translate business requirements into reliable data models and clearly defined metrics, balancing technical quality with practical business needs.

- Problem-Solving & Ownership: You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges, investigating root causes, and developing sustainable solutions.

- Design secure-by-design development workflows and CI/CD pipelines across our services, with expertise in Kubernetes security, container orchestration and identity management

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

The role

It's a hands-on, delivery-focused role, and you'll make an impact from the start in risk management, security advisory, customer and tender responses, audit readiness and our data strategy.

This isn't a security engineering role. You won't configure firewalls or run vulnerability scans. Instead, you'll understand our technical environment well enough to spot risks and gaps, then recommend best practices for Engineering, DevOps and IT to put in place. A background in compliance management alone won't be enough for this role.

You'll report to our Senior Information Security Officer, who owns our GRC framework, ISO 27001 programme, CE/CE+ & DSPT compliance, and the security risk register. You'll help deliver across all of it.

- Own risk management: run risk sessions across the business, keep the risk register current, write clear risk reports and chase treatment actions to completion

- Handle customers, tenders and suppliers: answer security questionnaires and tenders accurately, and assess suppliers before we approve them

- Keep us audit-ready: gather evidence all year round for Cyber Essentials Plus, DSPT and ISO 27001, and flag control gaps with practical fixes

- Deliver our data strategy: drive the data classification and access control programmes forward with data owners

You should apply if... 

- You have hands-on infosec and risk experience : ideally in health-tech, regulated SaaS or software development. You've run risk sessions, managed a risk register and reported on risk to senior stakeholders.

- You possess technical depth to hold your own: You understand authentication vs authorisation, least privilege, IAM, network segmentation and firewalls, patch and vulnerability management, endpoint protection and cloud infrastructure. 

- You understand frameworks: ISO 27001, DSPT, NIST and Cyber Essentials Plus, and a sense of what proportionate looks like in a fast-moving product company.

- You work fast and independently: You manage your own workload, flag blockers early and can move between a tender, a questionnaire and an engineering conversation in the same day.

- You care about healthcare: and know the data we protect belongs to patients and clinicians.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

The Role

As our first Head of Legal, you'll build Conveo's legal function from the ground up. Strategically critical commercial agreements with enterprise clients and reseller partners are coming in, and they require sharp commercial and legal review to protect our revenue lines. You will advise on a broad array of legal topics across commercial, product, IP, employment and corporate matters, with the support of external advisors and tools where appropriate.

This is a partnership role. You'll report to our CFO and work hand in hand with them, with a strong dotted line to our CEO. You'll have full strategic and operational visibility across the organisation and help strike the balance between risk and opportunity. Conveo operates across Europe and the US, so you'll also support our New York team and work across jurisdictions.

You'll lead our legal associate directly and manage our external lawyers. Legal here is both sword and shield for our commercial team. You'll be commercially pragmatic: working with the business, you'll make proportionate risk calls on the deal as a whole, not clause by clause, and you'll be prepared to work at pace. This role is based in our London office, in a hybrid setup (3 days a week in the office expected).

- Set fallback positions so deals don't stall, and tell the business clearly when to say no

- Build templates and playbooks so sales can close standard deals without you

Build the legal function

Own corporate, people and IP matters

description:

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

- 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in FinTech or B2B SaaS, with at least 2 years focused on ML or GenAI products

- Working knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation methods (not just "AI concepts" at a high level)

- Experience shipping AI products where output quality is probabilistic: you know how to define "good enough" and iterate from there

- Comfortable reading Python notebooks and SQL to interrogate model outputs and usage data

- Track record of shipping AI products where you managed the tension between ML research/exploration and production delivery constraints

- Collaborative leadership style with strong stakeholder management; you build relationships that empower your team to achieve outcomes

Nice to Have

The Opportunity 

9fin is already the leading platform for legal intelligence in debt capital markets. Our proprietary AI capabilities extract and analyse legal language at scale, and our unique dataset of credit legal documentation delivers intelligence that generic AI tools simply cannot match.

Now we are investing to extend that leadership. You will lead a dedicated engineering team to define the next chapter of 9fin's legal product — going deeper on AI, building richer workflows, and expanding into the law firm segment, where we see a significant TAM opportunity that is ours to capture.

Your users sit at the centre of the debt markets ecosystem: origination teams at top investment banks, lawyers at leading law firms, and credit analysts at hedge funds and credit funds.

This is a great opportunity to shape the future of a product and a company that's using technology to revolutionise the trillion-dollar debt capital market.

Product Strategy & Execution 

- Strategy: Define and champion the product vision and strategy for the Covenants squad from the ground up, working closely with engineering, our legal analysts, and key customers to establish what to build and why.

- Discovery: Use a range of techniques to identify and understand what users need and their workflows, across a sophisticated professional audience spanning credit analysts, portfolio managers, restructuring advisors, and law firms.

About You

You are comfortable using coding assistants to get things done faster and are genuinely excited about what this shift means for how product work gets done. This is not a nice-to-have. We expect our PMs to be at the frontier of how AI accelerates product development.

Benefits

About the role

We're looking for a Senior GenAI Engineer to build AI applications and agentic workflows for Motorway, taking them from rapid prototype through to production-grade systems that deliver measurable value.

Most of what makes a GenAI feature good sits around the model rather than in it. The prompting is rarely the hard part. Retrieval quality is, and so is the data feeding it, evaluation you can trust, sensible behaviour when things fail, and getting it live and keeping it there. If that's the work you want to do, we're not precious about the route you took to get here. Some of us came through data science and machine learning and deliberately built up our software engineering; others came the other way.

In this role, you will:

- Design evaluation and monitoring approaches that make quality, reliability and safety measurable rather than assumed.

- Build AI applications and agents using LLMs, orchestration, APIs and data systems, applying solid production software practices throughout.

- Make the calls on models, cost and latency that shape what a feature costs us to run, and document the reasoning so others can follow it.

- Prototype quickly, work out what is reusable, and harden the patterns that work into components the rest of the team adopts.

- Raise the quality of the work around you through code review, design feedback and the standards you set by example.

- Represent your technical decisions directly to product managers and stakeholders, translating model behaviour into business consequence.
