title: Responsable Réadaptation en Urgence
description:
Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 60 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 255 millions d'euros, avec 4794 employés dans le monde.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. 

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens.

CONTEXTE : 

La Direction des Programmes Internationaux (DPI) de Humanité & Inclusion comprend entre autres 5 Directions Géographiques, 4 Directions Techniques, 1 Direction Atlas Logistique et 1 Direction Urgence.

La Direction Urgence est composée de 15 personnes: une équipe en charge de la veille, de l'alerte et de la préparation aux urgences et une équipe en charge des interventions d'urgence au niveau du siège et sur le terrain. C’est au sein de cette dernière, composée de 6 spécialistes des urgences et prêts à être déployés sous 72 heures que nous recrutons un ou une Responsable Réadaptation physique et Fonctionnelle en Urgence dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire.

OBJECTIFS DU POSTE : 

Sous la responsabilité du responsable du pool d'urgence et en étroite coordination avec les Spécialistes en Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle du siège, le responsable Réadaptation Physique et Fonctionnelle d'urgence aura la charge de :

Participer au diagnostic initial des opérations de réponse d'urgence, à la suite d’une crise humanitaire ; 

· Contribuer à la définition de la stratégie, de la méthodologie et du dimensionnement du diagnostic initial, y compris la création et/ou l'adaptation des outils d'évaluation des besoins ;

· Participer aux évaluations des besoins ;

· Contribuer à l'analyse des résultats et à la définition de la stratégie de réponse immédiate en anticipant le nexus urgence-réhabilitation-développement ;

· Contribuer à l'élaboration du projet et à la rédaction des propositions ;

Diriger et coordonner : 

Piloter le déploiement des activités de réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle lors de l’ouverture de nouveaux programmes d’urgence, en assurant la définition du cadre opérationnel, le management des équipes, la coordination avec les autres secteurs d’intervention et les partenaires, ainsi que le suivi de la qualité, du budget, des résultats et du reporting. Le poste contribue également à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d’intervention d’urgence, au renforcement des capacités des équipes et partenaires, et à la capitalisation des retours d’expérience.

Représenter et promouvoir le mandat d’Humanité & Inclusion dans le cadre des réponses d’urgence dans votre domaine d’expertise ; 

· Promouvoir le mandat et son positionnement en coordination avec les partenaires de mise en œuvre ;

· Représenter et participer aux mécanismes de coordination des réponses liées à la Réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle d’urgence (groupe de travail santé, groupe de travail traumatologie etc…)

· Participer, sur demande de la hiérarchie, aux actions liées aux campagnes de plaidoyer et institutionnelles mises en œuvre par Humanité & Inclusion au siège et/ou sur le terrain ;

· Contribuer à la mobilisation des acteurs publics et privés pour assurer l’inclusion de la vulnérabilité et du handicap dans leurs programmes et initiatives.

Contribuer à la capitalisation institutionnelle et participer au développement et à la mise à jour des méthodologies, procédures, outils et formations d'urgence d’Humanité & Inclusion. 

· Participer aux travaux de formalisation et de capitalisation dans son domaine d'expertise en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de secteur et le spécialiste technique du siège ;

· Participer à la stratégie Direction Urgence et autres, si nécessaire ;

· Contribuer de façon proactive et constructive à la conception des processus et méthodologies de réponse aux urgences ;

· Contribuer au développement et/ou à l'optimisation des outils, procédures et ressources utilisés par Humanité & Inclusion pour la réponse aux urgences en étroite collaboration avec le spécialiste technique du siège.

· Contribuer au renforcement des capacités de réponse aux urgences du personnel et/ou des partenaires d'Humanité & Inclusion en fonction des besoins identifiés ;

· Contribuer à l'amélioration des outils et modules de formation dans ses domaines d'expertise ;

· Participer activement aux ateliers organisés au sein de l'Equipe de Réponse aux Urgences ou par d'autres départements au sein d'Humanité & Inclusion, en relation avec les réponses aux urgences

· Apporter un support au spécialiste technique du siège sur des sujets spécifiques et transversaux.

Requirements 

Vous avez une expérience d’au moins trois ans en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle en contexte d’urgence et votre situation personnelle actuelle vous permet d’être déployé sous 72 heures ? Voici plus en détail le profil requis pour ce poste passionnant ouvert dans le cadre d’un remplacement temporaire :

Formation / Connaissances 

- Un diplôme de kinésithérapeute ou ergothérapeute

- Une formation complémentaire en gestion et développement de projets / opérations humanitaires ou équivalent de préférence dans le domaine de l’action humanitaire internationale

- Bonne connaissance des réglementations et processus des bailleurs d’urgence

- Langues : anglais et français maitrisés. La maitrise de l’espagnol ou l’arabe serait un plus.

- Informatique : maitrise du Pack Office

Profil recherché 

- Expérience confirmée d’au moins 2 ans dans des fonctions de coordination ou de management de projets en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle.
- Solide expérience clinique récente en réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle, notamment dans les domaines de l’orthopédie, de la traumatologie, de la rééducation respiratoire et/ou des brûlés.
- Expérience significative dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de cadres d’intervention en réadaptation d’urgence (processus, méthodologies, outils et protocoles).
- Connaissance et/ou expérience complémentaire dans les domaines de la santé mentale et du soutien psychosocial (SMSPS) ainsi que de l’ inclusion .
- Expérience avérée en management, encadrement et représentation d’équipes pluridisciplinaires .
- Bonne maîtrise des mécanismes, réglementations et exigences des bailleurs de fonds humanitaires d’urgence .
- Expérience dans le développement et le pilotage de stratégies d’intervention humanitaire .
· Une expérience en évaluation initiale des besoins , ainsi qu’en missions d’ouverture ou de lancement de programmes d’urgence , constitue un atout majeur.

· Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (oral et écrit) indispensable. L'espagnol ou l'arabe est un plus.

Soft skills 

- Votre réactivité, votre grande capacité d’organisation et votre gestion du stress vous permettent de gérer une charge de travail importante dans un contexte sous pression

- Grâce à votre capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et à votre flexibilité vous savez vous adapter rapidement à de nouveaux contextes

- Bon communiquant et pédagogue vous aimez animer une équipe ou une formation. Vous êtes un bon « team player »

Benefits 

ACCESSIBILITE DU LIEU DE TRAVAIL : 

Les locaux sont facilement accessibles en transports en commun (bus, métro). Un parking voitures et un parc à vélos sont également à disposition. Au sein du bâtiment, des rampes d'accès et ascenseurs garantissent une meilleure circulation. Tous les postes de travail sont situés en Open Space mais des box sont disponibles à chaque étage pour travailler dans le calme si nécessaire. L’espace de travail est très lumineux. 

Une référente handicap est présente pour répondre aux éventuelles questions et vous accompagner dans vos démarches. En fonction de vos besoins, le poste peut être aménagé.

CONDITIONS DU POSTE : 

- CDD 4 mois

- Date de prise de poste : 15/11/26

- Carte Titres Restaurant,

- Mutuelle employeur,

- Statut cadre : 34 de congés payés et 13 jours de RTT annuels

- Accord télétravail avantageux,

- De nombreuses activités sportives et sociales sont proposées dans nos locaux

title: Un(e) Chef(fe) de Projets élections RH
description:

Kercia met à disposition une plateforme qui permet de gérer tous types d’élections avec des services adaptés à chaque organisation. Notre ambition : devenir le n°1 du vote électronique en France.

KERCIA appuie sa stratégie de croissance sur le développement d’un environnement qui permet à tous « Les KERCIENS » de bénéficier d’une expérience salarié positive, individuellement et collectivement.

Nous recherchons Un(e) Chef(fe) de Projets élections désireux de s’investir dans la réussite des objectifs de notre entreprise.

Ton poste et tes missions 

Rattaché(e) au Manager opérationnel, tu assureras la réalisation de projets de vote électronique pour les clients en garantissant la tenue des délais, le respect des obligations légales et réglementaires et en optimisant la satisfaction du client.

Tu seras basé(e) à Meylan, aux pieds des montagnes dans un bâtiment neuf au 5ième et dernier étage. Ce sont des espaces lumineux et modernes, avec une vuepanoramique à 360° sur les montagnes. Pour te repérer : https://share.google/8RQ9qsOwmtwZ1evCw

Tu évolueras au sein d’une équipe de Chef(fe)s de projets, experte dans son domaine et passionnée par sa mission.

Tes missions principales seront :

D’assurer la réalisation des projets dans le respect des critères de qualité et dans un objectif de satisfaction client 

- Organiser les réunions de lancement avec les clients :

- Proposer le planning établi en fonction des échéances du vote

- Valider les points juridiques clés

- Prendre en compte les attentes particulières du client

- Réaliser le paramétrage de l’outil de vote électronique en s’assurant de la validation par le client

- Piloter la réunion de scellement des urnes

- Superviser le déroulement des élections et intervenir en support de 2eme niveau en cas de sollicitation

- Animer la réunion de dépouillement des élections en rassurant sur la fiabilité du vote électronique

- Réaliser un bilan du projet et envoyer un questionnaire de satisfaction au client

- Organiser un point de débriefing avec le client pour les dossiers stratégiques 

De garantir le respect des obligations juridiques ou règlementaires particulières au projet 

- Recueillir auprès du client tous les documents d’entrée permettant d’évaluer les contraintes juridiques du client

- Rédiger et fournir au client les notes/fiches juridiques nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet

- Mettre en application les besoins juridiques du client (ex : échéances, sièges, quorum…)

- Conseiller sur leur adaptation aux spécificités du projet et attentes du client

- S’assurer de la prise en compte des règles juridiques (légales, conventionnelles) par le client tout au long du processus de vote

De contribuer à la sécurité de l’information dans le cadre de tes missions 

- Appliquer l’ensemble des politiques, procédures et bonnes pratiques de KERCIA en matière de sécurité de l’information dans tes activités de gestion de projets et de conseil juridique

- Veiller à la confidentialité, à l’intégrité et à la disponibilité des informations traitées (données électorales, données clients, documents juridiques, contrats, etc.)

- Signaler sans délai tout incident, suspicion d’incident ou non-conformité lié à la sécurité de l’information via les canaux internes prévus

- Participer, le cas échéant, aux actions de sensibilisation et d’amélioration continue en matière de sécurité de l’information (retours d’expérience, contribution à la FAQ interne, mise à jour de supports, etc.)

Tu travailleras en synergie avec l’ensemble des services de KERCIA (commercial, technique, administratif, direction, …) et tu participeras à l’ensemble des ateliers et à la vie quotidienne de la communauté Kercienne. Tu génèreras de l’impact et de la satisfaction client au travers de tes missions.

Partie intégrante du service opérationnel, le travail d’équipe et l’entraide sont au cœur des valeurs Kerciennes.

Ton profil 

Tes atouts et toi 

De formation supérieure bac+2 (BTS / DUT) à bac+3/4 , tu as une forte appétence pour la gestion de projets et le conseil.

Tu as acquis une expérience de 2 à 3 ans en Gestion des Ressources Humaines / Gestion de Projets ou Gestion Juridique (alternance incluse).

Des connaissances en matière d’Elections Professionnelles seraient un plus et des compétences en matière de Relations Sociales / Gestion du Climat Social / Droit social sont recherchées pour répondre aux attentes du poste

Diplomate, tu possèdes un bon relationnel, tu es reconnu(e) pour ton aisance orale et rédactionnelle.

Tu es agile et autonome, doté(e) d’une bonne capacité d’organisation et de priorisation. Ton état d’esprit est orienté solutions.

Tu sais faire preuve d’empathie et de bienveillance. Ton esprit de camaraderie et tes idées folles sont attendus sur ce poste !

Bonus : ton appétence pour les nouvelles technologies et ta maitrise du PACK OFFICE seraient un plus pour répondre pleinement aux attentes du poste.

Mobile, tu seras amené(e) à te déplacer sur l’ensemble du territoire pour le compte de tes clients. 

Des réunions de coordinations régulières auront également lieu au siège à Meylan (38).

Nous t’attendons pour une prise de poste à partir de novembre / décembre 2026.

Poste à pourvoir en CDD 12 mois / prime qualité / tickets restaurant / intéressement / séminaire d’entreprise.

À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap. 

Votre intégration chez Kercia : Dès votre premier jour, nous mettons tout en œuvre pour que vous soyez accueilli dans les meilleures conditions : votre poste de travail (PC, bureau ect.) est prêt et configuré, et un « Pack Welcome » vous attend. Pour faciliter vos débuts, un parrain dédié vous accompagne et des sessions « Vis-ma-Vie » sont organisées pour vous permettre de découvrir nos différents métiers. Chez Kercia, l'onboarding est un véritable parcours de plusieurs semaines conçu pour vous intégrer naturellement à l'équipe et vous accompagner dans vos nouvelles missions au sein d'un environnement attentif à l'épanouissement de chacun.

Rémunération et avantages

Package salariale pour ce poste comprise entre EUR 25,000 et 34,000 par an (fixe et variable).

Vous bénéficiez de 25 jours de congés payés par an.

- Access: connecting people and systems to approved AI models and tools

- Context: grounding AI in trusted Kraken knowledge, data and systems

- Enablement: reusable building blocks for AI-powered workflows and products

- Governance: permissions, safety, quality, cost and visibility across the lifecycle

- Context: Build the Kraken-specific knowledge layer to make LLMs useful. This covers our internal AI assistant, a structured "client brain" that captures client context and decisions, and pipelines that collect knowledge from tools like Notion, Slack and GitHub.

- Build shared AI platform services: Design, build and run Python services that other teams rely on, such as gateways, agent runtimes, knowledge pipelines and eval harnesses.

- Drive adoption: Work directly with engineers and non-technical teams, run workshops, write clear docs and turn feedback into product.

- Raise the engineering bar: Review designs and code, mentor others, and create patterns that can be reused across AI Foundations.

🧠 What you bring to the party 

- Strong senior-level software engineering: You have owned complex services end to end, from design through testing, deployment and operation.

- Deep engineering fundamentals: Good judgement on system design, concurrency, security, testing and architecture trade-offs. Strong production Python.

- Hands-on LLM and agent experience: You have built real things with LLMs, you know where they fail, and you use AI coding tools every day.

- Cloud experience: You're comfortable running services in AWS and owning their reliability and scalability.

- Product sense: You care whether people actually use what you build.

- Clear communication: You can explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical people and challenge ideas constructively.

- Learning agility: You pick up new tools and domains quickly in a field that changes every month.

🚀 What success looks like 

- Adoption: You ship platform features that teams across Kraken adopt and rely on.

title: AI Engineer H/F - Paris
description:
AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ?

AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital , créée en 2007. Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. 

Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Data Engineering, IA générative et LLM. Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets à forte valeur ajoutée pour faire de la Data un véritable levier de transformation. 

Nous intervenons auprès de clients aux secteurs d’activité variés, sur des missions qui combinent enjeux techniques, Data, IA et transformation opérationnelle. Selon votre profil et vos affinités, vous pourrez contribuer à des projets allant de la conception de prototypes jusqu’à la mise en production de solutions IA robustes, sécurisées et maintenables. 

Nos clients évoluent notamment dans les secteurs du Luxe, du Retail, des Télécoms, de la Banque, de l’Assurance et de l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques techniques variées. 

Quelques exemples de projets AI Engineer 

- Conception et développement d’agents autonomes pour automatiser des processus métiers : conception de workflows complexes, notamment dans l’industrie ou la relation client, dans lesquels des agents IA enchaînent des tâches, prennent des décisions et interagissent avec les outils et les données internes de l’entreprise. 

- Conception et orchestration de plateformes multi-agents : mise en place d’architectures dans lesquelles plusieurs agents IA spécialisés collaborent pour résoudre des problématiques complexes, par exemple en combinant recherche d’informations, synthèse et exécution de code, afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle. 

- Déploiement de plateformes Cloud : conception et déploiement d’environnements permettant de développer, sécuriser, superviser et faire évoluer des solutions IA. 

- Évaluation, observabilité et gouvernance des solutions IA : mise en place de dispositifs permettant de suivre la qualité, les coûts, les performances et la sécurité des applications IA, afin d’en garantir la fiabilité et la pérennité. 

AI Engineer – Data & IA (H/F)

Votre profil

Nous recherchons un profil de formation supérieure (Bac+5) en informatique, ingénierie logicielle, data ou domaine équivalent. 

Vous justifiez de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en développement Data & IA, en data engineering, machine learning engineering ou conception de solutions IA. Vous disposez de solides bases en Python et en développement logiciel : APIs, Git, tests, conteneurisation et CI/CD. 

Vous avez déjà participé à des projets d’industrialisation de solutions IA, idéalement autour du RAG, des agents IA, des environnements Cloud et de la mise en production. 

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne autonome, pragmatique et curieuse, capable de comprendre un besoin métier pour le traduire en solution technique concrète. Une bonne maîtrise du français et un niveau d’anglais technique sont attendus. 

Votre rôle en tant qu’AI Engineer 

Chez AVISIA, vous interviendrez sur des problématiques techniques variées, de la conception jusqu’au déploiement de solutions IA en production. 

Selon votre expérience, vos compétences et les projets, vous pourrez notamment intervenir sur : 

- L’analyse des besoins et la conception d’architectures IA adaptées aux enjeux métiers. 

- Le développement d’agents IA, de workflows et d’applications RAG . 

- L’intégration d’outils, d’APIs et de données d’entreprise. 

- Le développement d’APIs, de serveurs MCP et de services backend. 

- L’industrialisation et le déploiement de solutions dans des environnements Cloud. 

- La mise en place de tests, d’évaluations, de dispositifs d’observabilité et de sécurité. 

- La documentation des solutions et le partage des bonnes pratiques avec les équipes. 

Vous travaillerez en proximité avec les clients et les consultants AVISIA pour contribuer aux choix techniques, proposer des solutions pertinentes et faire progresser les expertises autour de l’IA générative. 

Les environnements techniques 

Pas besoin de maîtriser l’ensemble de ces technologies pour nous rejoindre ! Nous recherchons avant tout des profils solides en développement, curieux et motivés, avec l’envie d’apprendre et de monter en compétences sur les sujets d’IA générative, d’industrialisation et de Cloud. 

Selon vos compétences, vos envies et les projets sur lesquels vous interviendrez, vous pourrez être amené(e) à travailler avec différentes technologies : 

- Langages & frameworks : Python, SQL, Node.js, FastAPI, LangChain, ADK, LlamaIndex, APIs d’IA générative (OpenAI, Anthropic…). 

- DevOps & industrialisation : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git. 

- Plateformes Data & Cloud : Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Dataiku. 

L’objectif : vous permettre de développer progressivement votre expertise, de découvrir de nouvelles technologies et de construire un parcours professionnel qui vous ressemble. 

Ce que nous vous offrons 

Chez AVISIA, nous accordons autant d’importance à votre évolution professionnelle qu’à votre épanouissement au quotidien. 

- Un équilibre vie pro / vie perso , grâce à notre politique de télétravail. 

- Une mutuelle familiale pour prendre soin de vous et de vos proches. 

- Une formation continue via l’AVISIA School, pour développer vos compétences et rester à la pointe des technologies Data & IA. 

- Des certifications pour valoriser votre expertise et accompagner votre montée en compétences. 

- De réelles perspectives d’évolution : Contributeur, Senior, Tech Lead, Business Leader, Practice Leader… Plusieurs parcours sont possibles selon vos envies et vos ambitions.

Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets stimulants pour faire de la donnée un véritable levier de transformation.

Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques allant de l’analyse exploratoire des données à la conception, l’évaluation et l’industrialisation de modèles de Machine Learning.

Selon votre profil, vos compétences et vos affinités, vous pourrez intervenir sur des projets variés, de la conception de modèles prédictifs à leur déploiement en production, en passant par l’analyse des données et l’optimisation des performances. 

L’objectif : concevoir des solutions concrètes, exploiter pleinement le potentiel des données et contribuer directement à la prise de décision de nos clients.

title: Co-Founder & CTO (gn), Industrial Data for AI, Paris
description:
About FoodLabs 

FoodLabs is Europe's leading early-stage VC and venture studio, backing founders who are shaping the future of the food, health, and climate value chains. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. 

About The General Data Corporation 

General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. 

Why this is a unique opportunity 

AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. 

General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. 

About the role 

- Supplier intake: Build connectors for where companies actually keep their data: Databases, document stores, ticketing systems, machine logs, and sensor and video archives. 

- Transaction layer: Own the pipeline, rights evidence, contracts, permissions, audit trail and delivery API. 

- ML and data quality: Build anonymisation across text, tables, images and video, plus re-identification checks, deduplication, quality scoring and tooling that turns raw records into training-ready data. 

- Delivery and compute: Decide whether data is processed in our cloud or inside the supplier’s environment. Build secure delivery, recurring updates and our GPU infrastructure. 

- Technical direction: Own the architecture and roadmap. Work directly with labs, suppliers and researchers to understand what the system needs to become. 

What you need to succeed 

- Data infrastructure at scale: You have built pipelines for large unstructured datasets, such as video, images, sensor logs or documents, at terabyte scale or more. 

- Physical-world data: You have worked with documents, logs, video or sensor streams, ideally in robotics, industrial or autonomous systems and know what embodied AI teams need from data and where it breaks. 

- Sensitive data: You know how to handle personal and confidential data safely. Experience with regulated data is a plus. 

- Technical leadership: You make architectural decisions, explain them clearly and raise the engineering bar as the team grows. 

- Hands-on Builder: You have taken a product, platform or open-source project from 0 to 1 that others relied on, and you still write code and own the critical paths. 

- Founder mindset: You care about the outcome, not the title. You form strong views, test them quickly and are comfortable owning technical, product and operational problems. 

- Location: Paris preferred. English required; French is a plus. 

Please note: As a co-founder, you take a real stake in what we build. The compensation is a founder salary, and your upside grows with the company through your equity. Come build the infrastructure between AI and the world's data with us!

About Traila 

At Traila, we are dedicated to shaping the future of rail transport through cutting-edge technology. Since our founding in 2017, we have been driven by a passion for sustainability and excellence. We believe that rail transport is a cornerstone of a greener future, and our mission is to make it quieter, more efficient, and more reliable.

Our talented team is at the heart of this mission, and we are looking for an Industrial Software Engineer - Railway Applications to join us in developing robust software solutions that operate reliably in real-world railway environments.

What you will do 

- Industrial Software Development: Design, implement and maintain robust application software for industrial and railway products using C++, C#, Python or comparable technologies.

- Application & System Integration: Translate system and operational requirements into practical software functionality and integrate software with real hardware and physical systems.

- Hardware & Device Interfaces: Integrate sensors, actuators, controllers, DAQ systems and other industrial devices.

- Communication Protocols: Implement and troubleshoot interfaces such as CAN/CANopen, EtherCAT, TCP/IP and other industrial or vehicle communication protocols.

- Controls & Application Logic: Implement state machines, operational logic, control functionality and system behaviour required by the application.

- Commissioning & Field Support: Support installation, commissioning and field testing on prototypes, test systems and rail vehicles, including travel to customer and test sites when required.

- Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Analyse logs, interfaces and system behaviour to identify root causes and solve software and integration issues efficiently.

- Testing & Validation: Develop unit, integration and system-level tests and contribute to HIL/SIL or other validation activities where relevant.

- Software Architecture, Quality & Controlled Releases: Own software architecture and release discipline, including configuration and version control, code reviews, test evidence and controlled software releases.

- Product Cybersecurity: Own threat assessment, secure access and software updates, vulnerability handling and lifecycle security maintenance; coordinate specialist security reviews and work with Systems/RAMS on vehicle interfaces and safety consequences.

- Technical Guidance & Mentoring: Review implementations, share practical software-engineering practices and mentor colleagues to strengthen consistency, maintainability and technical ownership across the team.

- Tools & Data: Develop tools for configuration, testing, diagnostics, data acquisition and analysis that support engineering and field activities.

- Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain clear software and interface documentation and improve existing code as Traila products mature from development into deployed systems.

What you bring 

- Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience.

- Hands-on professional software-development experience in an industrial, automation, automotive, machinery or comparable technical environment.

- Proven professional railway software experience, including products released and maintained in service.

- Strong practical programming skills in C++, C#, Python or a comparable industrial software stack; you do not need to be an expert in every language listed.

- Experience developing software that interacts with real hardware, devices or physical systems.

- Experience taking software beyond prototypes into tested, maintainable and deployable industrial use.

- Practical railway software lifecycle experience aligned with EN 50716:2023, including requirements traceability, configuration management and verification/validation appropriate to the required software integrity level; relevant EN 50128 / EN 50657 predecessor experience is also valuable.

- Practical embedded or industrial cybersecurity experience, including secure credentials and access, signed software updates and rollback, and handling vulnerabilities in released products.

- Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, communication and hardware interfaces.

- Experience with Git and structured software-development workflows.

- A practical ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with prototypes, test equipment and deployed systems and driving technical problems through to resolution.

- Ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines and communicate technical issues clearly.

- Fluent English; German is a strong advantage.

Nice to have 

- Experience with industrial Linux, embedded Linux, automation or control systems.

- MATLAB/Simulink, HIL/SIL testing, data acquisition or condition-monitoring experience.

- Working knowledge of railway cybersecurity under CLC/TS 50701:2023 and of EN IEC 62443-4-1 (secure development) and EN IEC 62443-4-2 (component security) is desirable.

- Familiarity with EN 50155 and EN 50126 for equipment integration and collaboration with Systems/RAMS.

- Experience in a regulated or safety-relevant product-development environment.

Benefits

- Flexible working hours and home office options.

- Annual professional development allowance for courses, certifications and conferences.

- Competitive compensation with milestone bonus scheme and full Swiss social coverage.

- A collaborative team culture with regular social and sports activities.

title: Network Customer Support Engineer
description:
Location: Zurich, Paris or Munich

About Us 

Point One Navigation is building the future of precise location. Our mission is to deliver a unified location platform that enables autonomy, safety, and efficiency across industries from robotics to transportation. We are a high-performance, high-collaboration team that thrives on solving complex problems, moving fast, and delivering impact.

Role Outcome 

The Network Customer Support Engineer owns the customer support experience tied to the reliability, visibility, and operational health of Point One’s correction network.

This is a player-coach role. You will personally handle complex technical support cases while also leading the operational systems, monitoring, and processes that ensure the network performs reliably at scale.

Success in this role means:

- Potential customer facing issues are identified and addressed before they impact customers.

- When incidents do occur, they are resolved quickly with clear communication and strong root-cause analysis.

- The organization has clear visibility into network health, operational trends, and customer friction.

- A scalable network operations and support function is built as the company and network footprint grow.

Immediate Areas of Focus 

Own the customer experience of our Network

- Work with our Network Operations team to understand incidents that affect the customer experience

- Identify emerging issues and collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams to understand and support the resolution of those issues.

- Understand available metrics and dashboards and contribute to the development of these tools to allow for the targeted resolution of customer questions.

Deliver High-Quality Technical Support

- Liaison between Engineering, Network Operations and FAE and FDE team to support the customer.

- Personally manage high-impact or technically complex support cases.

- Partner closely with FAEs, Product, and Engineering to diagnose issues and close the loop with customers.

- Ensure customers receive clear, confident communication during investigations and incidents.

- Model best-in-class technical troubleshooting and customer engagement practices for the team.

Build the Foundation for a Scalable Operations & Support Function

- Design and implement systems that enable both network operations and customer support to scale.

- Define a support ticket taxonomy that reflects customer use cases, technical complexity, and operational impact.

- Support Network Ops team on operational metrics such as:

- Network uptime and availability

- Incident response and resolution times

- Support response and resolution times

- Alert quality and monitoring coverage

- Document operational procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models.

- Develop automation and tooling to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.

Surface Operational and Customer Insights

- Identify patterns across support tickets, network events, and operational data.

- Translate operational signals into actionable insights for Product and Engineering.

- Ensure recurring issues and infrastructure gaps are clearly surfaced and prioritized.

- Create lightweight reporting that gives leadership visibility into network reliability, operational trends, and customer friction.

Establish Visibility Into Customer Experience

- Define and implement the right metrics for understanding customer experience and operational impact.

- Establish mechanisms to collect structured customer feedback without creating noise.

- Use both operational data and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

Coach and Develop the Operations & Support Function

- Act as a player-coach, leading through hands-on operational work while building the foundations of the team.

- Train and mentor support engineers on troubleshooting methodology, operational awareness, and customer communication.

- Establish clear expectations for technical depth, ownership, and responsiveness.

- Continuously raise the operational and support bar as the team grows.

Qualifications 

- Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English.

- Experience in a player-coach technical operations or support role where you owned both hands-on troubleshooting and operational systems.

- Strong technical background in GPS/GNSS, precise localization, geospatial infrastructure, or closely related domains (robotics, autonomy, embedded systems, positioning technologies).

- Experience operating or supporting distributed infrastructure or network-based systems.

- Demonstrated ability to build or significantly improve monitoring, alerting, and operational processes.

- Proven experience troubleshooting complex technical systems and working directly with customers.

- Experience conducting incident response and root cause analysis.

- Ability to define metrics, processes, and documentation without over-engineering.

- Comfort working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market teams in a fast-moving environment.

- Bias toward ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Our Cultural Foundation 

At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position.

This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact . It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them.

That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today , not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows.

We think about our culture in two dimensions:

How We Show Up Every Day 

These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate:

- Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting.

- High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us.

- Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles.

- No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together.

- Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust.

Operating Principles 

These are the systems and norms that amplify speed and efficiency at the company level:

- Edge Innovation — We bias toward action over approval. Experiment, decide, and move — failure is just a step toward faster learning.

- No Hierarchies — We practice self-prioritization and go direct to the source. Flattening layers reduces drag and maximizes autonomy.

- Customer Experience First — We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most.

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply below and join us in shaping the future of precise location.

title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

What you’ll do

- Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

- Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

- Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

- Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

- Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

- Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

- Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

- Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

- NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

- JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

- A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

- Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

- A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

- Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have: 

- Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

- Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

- Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

- Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer 

- Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

- Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

- Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer 

- Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

- Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

- Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP 

- Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

- Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

- Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

- Team: regular team events.

Practical information

- Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

- If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

About the role: 

As a Site Reliability Engineer at DeepJudge, you own the reliability of the systems that leading law firms depend on every day. We run our AI search platform in dedicated production environments, each a large-scale search and retrieval system operating at very high data volumes, alongside our ingestion pipelines and data stores, on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds. Keeping those environments fast, available, and trustworthy is a genuine engineering challenge, and it's your mission.

This is a technical, infrastructure-focused role: you'll spend your time in systems, code, and telemetry. You'll harden the platform so that classes of failure can't recur, build observability and SLOs to let us see problems before they surface, plan capacity ahead of relentless data growth, and automate away the toil of safely operating many production environments. You'll work across our deployment and infrastructure-as-code and partner closely with product engineering to feed reliability learnings back into the platform. If you like operating serious distributed systems at scale and turning firefighting into engineered reliability, this role is for you.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Owning the availability, latency and performance of our production environments: large-scale search and retrieval services, ingestion and data stores on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds

- Owning the cloud infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds, networking, identity and access, compute and storage, and managing cloud capacity, quotas and cost as the fleet grows

- Improving deployment and infrastructure through code: GitOps-based configuration and deployment and infrastructure-as-code across our public and private clouds, with safe, previewed, recoverable production changes

- Defining and instrumenting SLOs and error budgets and building the dashboards, metrics and alerting that make production observable and actionable

- Reducing operational toil through automation and internal tooling written in Python and / or Go

- Provisioning and standardizing new production environments to a defined reliability bar

You're a great fit if you: 

- Have 3+ years in SRE, production / platform engineering, or infrastructure-heavy software engineering, operating real production systems under reliability expectations

- Are strong at container-orchestration operations in production and comfortable on at least one major public cloud

- Have solid cloud infrastructure experience on a major public cloud and a working grasp of cloud capacity, quotas, and cost

- Practice observability hands-on with metrics, logs and traces, and use it to root-cause live incidents

- Work fluently with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps

- Can code in Python and / or Go for automation, tooling, and reading and patching service code.

- Bring sound production judgment and document your work clearly for other engineers

- Bonus: experience operating a large-scale search or distributed data system, database operations, dedicated / enterprise-deployed software, or AI / enterprise-search infrastructure in regulated domains

What you can look forward to: 

- Owning the reliability of systems that the world's leading law firms rely on: real scale, real impact

- Deep, hands-on work with modern infrastructure: distributed search at very large scale, container orchestration across multiple clouds, and a mature infrastructure-as-code and GitOps stack

- A rigorous, high-urgency engineering culture founded by ex-Google search engineers and ETH Zurich AI PhDs

- The chance to build the reliability discipline, SLOs, incident practice, automation, from a strong foundation, not inherit a rigid one

- A collaborative team in Zurich shaping how AI transforms professional knowledge work

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers — from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

The day-to-day:

- Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

- Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform

- Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

- Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected

- Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts — new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts.

Responsibilities 

- Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management.

- Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity).

- Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means.

- Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly.

- Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs.

- Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns.

- Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures.

- Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals.

- Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up.

- Build error-recovery logic so that when something fails mid-run, the system retries, skips, alerts, or pauses depending on the failure mode.

- Create monitoring and observability for work-cell health: instrument status, run progress, error rates.

- Debug across the software–hardware boundary — figuring out whether bad data is a comms, firmware, calibration, or code problem.

description:
Ben jij een Senior Quality Engineer die verder kijkt dan het oplossen van afwijkingen? Iemand die kwaliteit ziet als een stuurinstrument en het voortouw neemt in structurele verbetering? Dan bieden wij jou een rol waarin je écht het verschil maakt. 

Als Senior Quality Engineer ben je een sleutelspeler in het naar een hoger volwassenheidsniveau brengen van onze kwaliteitsperformance. Je acteert proactief, signaleert risico’s vóórdat ze problemen worden en stuurt op duurzame oplossingen. Je bent geen volger van processen, maar mede‑vormgever van hoe kwaliteit wordt geborgd, verbeterd en beleefd wordt bij ons.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het inhoudelijk en methodisch leiden van verbetertrajecten, waaronder het aanjagen en begeleiden van het Quality Improvement Team (QIT‑proces). Je fungeert daarbij als coach, challenger en inhoudelijk geweten.

Wat ga je, onder andere, doen? 

- Proactief analyseren van kwaliteitsafwijkingen, trends en risico’s om structurele, systeemgedreven oorzaken bloot te leggen.

- Leiden van root cause analyses en borgen van effectieve, duurzame CAPA’s.

- Initiëren, ontwikkelen en borgen van kwaliteitsstandaarden, procedures en werkinstructies.

- Voorbereiden, uitvoeren en doelgericht benutten van interne en externe audits.

- Analyseren en vertalen van kwaliteits‑KPI’s naar concrete verbeteracties en besluitvorming.

- Regie voeren op kwaliteit binnen NPI‑projecten, inclusief kritische beoordeling van deliverables en klantspecificaties.

Waar maak jij het verschil? 

Je werkt intensief samen met productie, engineering, supply chain en klanten, maar neemt vooral ook inhoudelijk leiderschap. Je stelt de juiste vragen, doorbreekt reactieve patronen en helpt de organisatie om kwaliteit voorspelbaar, robuust en toekomstbestendig in te richten. Binnen het team krijg je ruimte om verbeterinitiatieven te initiëren, anderen daarin mee te nemen en samen te bepalen waar jouw expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt.

Kortom: een rol voor een professional die eigenaarschap neemt, vooruitdenkt en kwaliteit structureel naar het volgende niveau brengt.

Wat biedt Benchmark? 

Werken bij Benchmark betekent werken in een dynamische werkomgeving. Je werkt in een zelfstandig team waar jouw initiatieven en ideeën zeer op prijs worden gesteld. Het tonen van initiatief wordt erg gewaardeerd en beloond.

Je werkt in een team van 8 directe collega’s. Het team waarin je werkt is hecht en ieder jaar kan je rekening op een gezellig teamuitje! Daarbuiten zorgt Benchmark voor genoeg activiteiten, zoals een jaarlijks zomerfeest en Kerstfeest.

Daarnaast bieden wij:

- Goed salaris: met een range €4.795,- tot €6.842,- bruto per maand op fulltime basis. Je wordt ingeschaald op basis van je eerdere (aansluitende) werkervaring, waarbij we uiteraard jouw salarisindicatie ook in meenemen.

- Kwartaalbonus: deze is omzetafhankelijk en kan oplopen tot max. 5% van je kwartaalsalaris.

- Vakantie: geniet van 40 vrije dagen per jaar (27 vakantiedagen én 13 ATV-dagen).

- Ruimte voor groei- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden: bijvoorbeeld door deel te nemen aan één van de vele trainingen van onze Benchmark Academy, maar ook door opleidingen te volgen die passen bij jouw wensen en bij ons als organisatie.

- Flexibele werktijden: zolang jij zorgt dat je werk af is, is er bij ons de mogelijkheid om op een flexibele manier je werktijden in te delen.

- Deelname aan ons BE-Fit programma: sporten met collega’s op kosten van Benchmark. Samen hebben we al gekickbokst, cross-fit gedaan en padelclinics gevolgd.

Wat zien wij graag in onze toekomstige collega? 

- Een afgeronde technische opleiding in de richting van Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Elektronica of Technische Bedrijfskunde.

- Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in een Quality‑rol, bij voorkeur binnen een hightech‑ of productieomgeving.

- Je werkt methodisch en gestructureerd en past bewezen kwaliteits‑ en verbetermethodieken toe (bijv. RCA, CAPA, Lean Six Sigma).

- Je neemt eigenaarschap over verbeterinitiatieven en realiseert deze van analyse tot duurzaam geborgd resultaat.

Over ons 

Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s). 

Bij ons werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd.

Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met ongeveer 650 collega’s.

Wij zoeken collega’s die samen met ons de toekomst vorm geven, zichzelf en anderen inspireren, nieuwe uitdagingen aangaan en vooruitziende oplossingen bedenken. Spreekt dit jou aan? We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie!

title: Senior C++ Firmware Engineer (VNA & Test & Measurement)
description:
At Benchmark, we develop innovative technology solutions that help our customers bring advanced products to market. Our engineers work on complex systems in high-tech environments, contributing to products that require precision, performance, and reliability.

To support the continued development of advanced RF and Test & Measurement solutions, we are looking for a highly skilled Senior C++ Firmware Engineer with expertise in Vector Network Analyzers (VNA), RF measurements, and instrument software development .

This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge measurement systems, extending instrument capabilities into the mmWave domain while collaborating with international engineering teams operating at the forefront of high-frequency technology.

The Role 

As a Senior C++ Firmware Engineer, you will take technical ownership of software subsystems within advanced Test & Measurement products. You will contribute to the integration of mmWave converter functionality, development of calibration-related features, firmware verification, and enhancement of VNA measurement capabilities up to 170 GHz.

You are comfortable working with large existing software architectures and can effectively analyze, modify, and extend complex instrument software while maintaining product quality and performance.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong C++ development capabilities with practical understanding of RF measurements, calibration concepts, and automated verification methodologies.

You will also leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, or similar technologies to improve development efficiency while maintaining full engineering ownership of the solution delivered.

Your Responsibilities 

- Take technical ownership of firmware and software subsystems within advanced Test & Measurement products

- Analyze and extend existing C++ software architectures and instrument software platforms

- Develop and integrate new functionality for VNA and mmWave measurement systems

- Implement calibration-related features and measurement workflows

- Support integration of mmWave converters and high-frequency measurement capabilities

- Design, implement, and maintain SCPI-controlled instrument functionality

- Develop and execute automated verification and validation activities

- Create and maintain Python-based test automation frameworks

- Perform debugging, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization

- Ensure software quality through unit, integration, and system testing

- Collaborate with system architects, firmware engineers, hardware engineers, and customer-facing technical teams

- Identify technical risks, dependencies, and integration challenges at an early stage

- Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices

- Apply AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity, code quality, testing, and documentation

What You Bring

Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field

- Strong professional experience with modern C++ software development

- Experience working with large-scale instrument software or firmware codebases

- Experience with C++ templates, generic programming, and modern software design principles

- Experience with Qt application development

- Experience with firmware development, hardware communication, and device control

- Advanced knowledge of multithreading and concurrent software architectures

- Experience with Visual Studio and CMake-based development environments

- Strong understanding of SCPI protocols and instrument control

- Experience with Python-based automated testing and verification

- Experience with unit, integration, and system-level testing

- Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, or similar technologies

- Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical problem-solving skills

- Ability to independently execute work packages and take technical ownership

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

- Experience collaborating within distributed or international engineering teams using Git

Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with Vector Network Analyzers (VNA)

- RF measurement and calibration expertise

- Knowledge of S-parameter measurements, leveling, and ALC concepts

- Experience within the Test & Measurement industry

- Experience with mmWave converters and high-frequency measurement systems

- Familiarity with Spectrum Analyzer or Signal Generator products

- Experience with automated test frameworks such as PyTest

- Experience working within remote or customer-hosted development environments

- Experience interacting directly with technical customer stakeholders

Nice to Have 

- Knowledge of high-frequency RF systems above 110 GHz

- Digital Design Test (DDT) experience

- On-wafer measurement experience

- Familiarity with measurement simulation environments

- Experience with Jira and Confluence

- Dutch communication skills are desirable

What Benchmark Offers

title: Medior C++ Software Engineer
description:
About Vitestro 

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

As a Medior C++ Engineer, you will take ownership of software components within our hardware-integrated systems. You will design, implement, and improve robust C++ software that interacts with multiple subsystems, and real-time environments. You will collaborate closely with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers to ensure system reliability, maintainability, and performance.

First months at Vitestro 

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro's software architecture, hardware-integrated systems, and development processes. You build an understanding of how our software interacts with different subsystems and start contributing to the design, implementation, and improvement of software components in modern C++ (C++17/20).

Working closely with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers, you become familiar with our state-machine-based logic, DDS communication protocols, and Linux and real-time environments. You contribute to debugging, automated testing, and code reviews while building the knowledge needed to take ownership of software components.

After your first month you will be able to contribute to the velocity of the team by working on new features in the scope of the motion team. You will be able to solve complex integration issues coming from production and the field.

This is what success looks like 

After 12 months, you have taken ownership of software components within our hardware-integrated systems. You confidently design, implement, and maintain robust C++ software that interacts with multiple subsystems and real-time environments.

You actively contribute to improving the existing software architecture, ensuring maintainability, scalability, and performance. You design and maintain structured state-machine-based logic, integrate evolving hardware components into the software stack, and contribute to system-level design discussions and technical decisions.

You work effectively with hardware engineers, systems engineers, and other software developers to debug complex issues across software and hardware boundaries. You have contributed to improving testability and automated verification strategies, actively participate in code reviews, and help raise software quality standards.

After your first year, you will own significant nontrivial features and parts of the code-base of the team. You will be a key knowledge holder of the implementation of the motion software unit as well as accuracy calibrations and verifications. You actively engage in building the roadmap for the coming years together with other engineers.

What You'll Bring: 

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

- 4–7 years of experience developing C++ software in a professional environment.

- Proven experience designing and maintaining production-level software systems.

- Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20).

- Experience structuring code for maintainability and scalability.

- Experience with automated testing.

- Experience working in Linux environments.

- Strong debugging skills in complex systems.

- Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows.

Nice to Have: 

- Experience designing and implementing state machines.

- Experience with hardware–software integration.

- Familiarity with DDS or similar pub/sub communication frameworks.

- Experience working in real-time or near real-time systems.

- Python scripting experience.

- Exposure to robotics or industrial communication protocols (EtherCAT, CANopen).

What we offer: 

- Competitive salary including pension plan

- 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position

- Hybrid work model

- Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht

- Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away

- Annual training budget of €2000,-

- Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics

We offer an environment where you can make a lot of impact, as you are joining a growing scale-up in MedTech. Our team of driven and talented colleagues enjoys solving the challenges in developing, manufacturing, and completing our breakthrough medical device. While working in an open culture, we strive for excellence in all domains. We believe in taking courage and like to challenge each other. We learn and teach, regardless of age, nationality or gender.

title: Senior Quality Systems Officer
description:
About Vitestro 

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. 

As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. 

You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. 

This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward. 

First months at Vitestro 

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements. 

This is what success looks like: 

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward. 

What You’ll Bring: 

- Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved.

- Experience working in a regulated environment.

- Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work.

- A systematic, process-oriented way of working.

- The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems.

- A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements.

- The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed.

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field

- Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices.

Nice to have: 

- Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working.

- Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required.

- Experience with MDSAP 

How We Work 

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

- We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

- We focus on execution and delivering results.

- We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

- We challenge ideas, not people.

- We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

- We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

- Competitive salary including pension plan 

- 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position 

- Hybrid work model 

- Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht 

- Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away.

- Training budget 

- Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics 

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!
