title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
Senior AI/ML Engineer, remote in Canada: own the AI that assesses patients for US healthcare providers and gets them to the right mental health care faster. 

About Limbic 

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomized, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

The Role 

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will take ownership of the AI in our clinical assessment product for US healthcare organizations. A patient describes what they are struggling with in a conversation with our AI, which gathers their history, administers standard clinical questionnaires such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, detects risk and recommends a treatment program for the organization’s clinicians to review. Every organization configures it for its own services, so the AI has to be safe and accurate across many clinical setups, not just one.

The approach is proven at scale in the NHS, where it increased referrals from minority groups by 29%, as published in Nature Medicine. You will work in North American hours alongside product, engineering and clinical colleagues, in close collaboration with our ML team in London. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across Limbic.

What You’ll Do 

- 
Own the quality of the conversational AI that runs patient assessments, from each step of the conversation to clinical prediction and treatment recommendation.

- 
Improve the safety checks that screen every patient message and AI reply, covering risk, attempts to manipulate the AI, unsafe medical advice and clinically inappropriate responses, so they catch more problems without flagging good replies.

- 
Productionize ML models that optimize product KPIs, including the accuracy of clinical predictions and how quickly patients reach the right care.

- 
Build and maintain evaluation harnesses, simulated patient conversations and labelled transcript review, so every configuration can be tested before a patient sees it.

- 
Extend our assessment AI to new channels, including the phone, so that patients who cannot or will not use a web form still have a way in.

- 
Help turn our clinical AI into composable services that healthcare partners can integrate into their own patient journeys.

- 
Build agents and tooling that automate product development workflows, including reliable testing and customer demos.

- 
Raise the engineering bar through architecture, code review and mentorship, while keeping our AI continuously compliant with strict regulatory requirements.

What You’ll Bring 

- 
You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:

- 
A PhD in computational science or an AI-related field, plus 2 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

- 
OR A BSc/MSc, plus 4 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

- 
Expertise in productizing LLM features and a strong background in eval-driven development.

- 
Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.

- 
Proven experience building an LLM agent harness .

- 
Experience utilizing reinforcement learning.

- 
Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications.

- 
A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics.

- 
Proficiency with version control systems (preferably Git) and databases (SQL or NoSQL).

- 
Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerization technologies.

- 
A track record of end-to-end ownership: you scope work you can ship quickly, measure its impact, and keep a sense of urgency when the stakes are high.

- 
A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space.

- 
Ideal but not required: Experience with real-time voice AI, or with healthcare organizations as customers.

- 
North American business hours (Eastern time preferred), with daily overlap with colleagues in Europe (UTC to UTC+3).

- 
Based in Canada with the right to work there.

- 
Please note: Limbic cannot provide visa sponsorship in Canada.

Benefits & Wellbeing 

- 
Salary: CA$173,000 – CA$192,000 per year.

- 
Equity share options.

- 
25 days PTO.

- 
Support with purchasing work-related books and materials.

- 
Quarterly Life Days: Enjoy 4 paid days off per year (one each quarter) to use whenever you choose to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters.

- 
Mental Health Support: Access to dedicated mental health support services.

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group .

ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

Profile Overview

This is the hard end of web scraping. The sites we rely on, Google, Amazon, Walmart and many others, actively work to block us, and they change the rules without warning. We're looking for a senior engineer who can go deep on why we're being blocked, work out how the detection actually functions, and design repeatable ways around it. You'll be joining a self-driven, high-autonomy team to take on our most involved problems, with the room and the trust to build something from close to a blank page: an environment that turns one-off breakthroughs into a methodical, repeatable way of defeating anti-bot systems. If you like confronting problems that genuinely resist you, and you work methodically rather than by trial and error, this is an unusually open brief.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

- Getting a full local environment running and becoming fluent in our systems and how they operate, in the first few weeks.

- Contributing to a proposal on the design for a repeatable environment we can pose anti-bot problems to and get reliable analysis out of.

- Building that environment out over the following months so that, by month six, we can point it at a target or provider and have it reliably tell us how we're being blocked and what is and isn't being used against us.

Your responsibilities

- Analyse how specific anti-bot and bot-mitigation systems (the likes of DataDome, Cloudflare Turnstile, Kasada, PerimeterX and Akamai) detect and block us, and design systems to work around them.

- Turn isolated breakthroughs into durable, repeatable processes: hypothesis, test, discard what's wrong, move on.

- In collaboration with other senior team members, design and build a greenfield agentic environment that can propose and run tests on anti-bot behaviour and bypass approaches, and do it in a way that's well understood and repeatable.

- Work largely independently on deep, concentrated problems, while actively pulling in knowledge from across the wider engineering team.

- Communicate clearly what you plan to do, and step into major incidents when the team needs your depth.

What you bring to the table

- Deep, genuine understanding of how the internet works underneath: HTTP, TLS and fingerprinting, proxies, headers, cookies, and browser behaviour. This is the core of the role and it isn't something we can shortcut.

- Excellent problem-solving built on a scientific, methodical approach: you form a hypothesis, design a test, read the result honestly, and iterate. Trying things at random is the opposite of what this role needs.

- Strong hands-on skills in our stack, Node.js and TypeScript with solid Python, and comfort across backend systems at scale (Postgres, Redis/Valkey, MongoDB, Puppeteer/Camoufox, Kubernetes).

- Real skill at directing AI coding agents with precision, and the judgement to tell strong output from weak. The specific tool doesn't matter (Claude, Codex or similar); knowing how to steer it well is what counts.

- A background that has given you this kind of depth and rigour. That might be scraping, anti-bot or web-security work, reverse engineering, or a research or academic path where you built your own tooling and lived by the scientific method. Direct scraping experience is a strong plus rather than a strict requirement.

- Independence and strong communication: you're comfortable owning hard problems in a remote-first team with little hand-holding, and you keep the team in the loop on your thinking as you go.

What's in it for you

- Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.

- Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

- Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

- Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

- Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.

- Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

title: Staff Full Stack Engineer
description:
Mattermost is the leading collaborative workflow platform for defense, intelligence, security, and critical infrastructure. Trusted by the U.S. Department of War and Fortune 500s, our platform runs on-premises and in private clouds, delivering secure messaging, file sharing, workflow automation, audio/screenshare, and project management—all with full data and operational control. Mattermost powers high-stakes workflows across mission planning, real-time, real-world operations, DevSecOps, incident response, and cyber defense—enabling secure collaboration from tactical edge and DDIL environments to enterprise HQ. Teams operate across web, desktop, and mobile, with embedded interoperability for Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365.

To learn more, visit www.mattermost.com 

We are seeking a Staff Full Stack Engineer to set the technical direction for and scale Mattermost’s core web platform for teams operating in defense and critical infrastructure sectors. You’ll drive architecture and technical strategy across our Go backend and React/TypeScript web frontend — partnering across teams to ship features that hold up under strict security, compliance, and reliability requirements . 

Our engineering culture is AI-forward. We expect engineers to work fluently with AI coding agents such as Claude Code day-to-day — for scaffolding, refactors, code review, and test generation — and treat that as core craft rather than a shortcut. We would rather hire smart people who get stuff done than chase an exact tech-stack match. If you have a track record of shipping and owning complex software end-to-end, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Do 

- Define and drive the technical architecture and roadmap for Mattermost’s core web platform across multiple engineering teams, spanning Go, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Redis

- Set org-wide standards and best practices for AI-agentic engineering workflows — going beyond personal fluency with tools like Claude Code and Cursor to shape how the broader engineering org adopts them, while retaining accountability for correctness, security, and design decisions

- Lead the internal tooling and testing infrastructure strategy that speeds up delivery for the broader engineering org, not just your immediate team

- Own the testing strategy and quality bar across frontend and backend systems, and hold other engineers accountable to it through design reviews and mentorship

- Drive architectural decisions for REST and WebSocket API design, grounded in deep networking fundamentals

- Partner directly with security, compliance, and product leadership on strategic technical bets tied to our government and enterprise customer requirements

- Mentor senior engineers and act as a technical multiplier across the org

- Contribute to and help shape technical direction for Mattermost’s open-source codebase

What We Are Looking For 

Required:

- Senior full-stack development experience in Go and React (or a comparable stack), with a track record of owning complex systems end-to-end

- Proven experience designing and owning distributed systems or high-availability service architecture at scale

- Experience designing and consuming REST and WebSocket APIs with solid networking fundamentals

- Relational database experience including PostgreSQL, schema design, and query optimization

- Hands-on daily fluency directing AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot for scaffolding, refactors, code review, and test generation — with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to take the wheel yourself

- Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams without relying on formal authority

- Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar for a broader team

- Comfortable operating in regulated or high-compliance environments (e.g., enterprise security, government, or critical infrastructure requirements)

Nice to Have:

- Prior experience operating as a staff, principal, or technical lead engineer at another company

- Experience maintaining (not just contributing to) an open-source project

- Program-level familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to defense or government customers (e.g., FedRAMP, ITAR)

- Experience helping scale engineering practices or standards across a growing organization

- Background in defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure products

- Experience building tools, skills, or workflows on top of AI coding agents including MCP servers, agent skills, or CI-integrated agents

How Success Is Measured 

First 90 Days: Build cross-team credibility by shipping a meaningful full-stack feature on the core platform, while assessing the technical landscape and identifying the highest-leverage architectural or process improvements to pursue.

Why Mattermost 

- Mission-driven work: Your contributions directly support the organizations and missions that depend on secure, reliable collaboration including the U.S. Department of War and critical infrastructure operators worldwide

- Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a globally distributed, high-trust team built for autonomy and ownership

- AI-forward environment: We actively adopt and build AI-enabled workflows. Agentic development is core craft here, not a novelty

- End-to-end ownership: Ship and own complex software across the full stack with real accountability for what you build

- Open source at the core: Be part of a vibrant developer community shaping the future of secure collaboration

Compensation 

Mattermost takes a market-based approach to pay. Actual compensation may vary based on location, skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions.

Target Salary Range: $172,724 – $227,135

U.S. Eligibility & Compliance 

This role may require obtaining and maintaining a U.S. government security clearance. Candidates must meet federal eligibility requirements to be considered. For more information visit Security Clearances — United States Department of State 

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for access to export-controlled information as defined by U.S. export control laws, including EAR and ITAR. For more information visit the Bureau of Industry and Security and the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls .

Mattermost is an EEO Employer, we are a remote-first, open-source company.

We are continually working to expand our hiring in more countries and regions, ensuring compliance with local laws and regulations, which takes time.

Mattermost values your unique perspective—we welcome all applicants. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply and are committed to assessing candidates based on their skills and qualifications. We do not tolerate discrimination against staff or applicants based on race, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or other personal characteristics.

If you require accommodations during the interview process, please let us know—we’re happy to assist.

title: Backend Software Engineer, SDK
description:
About LaunchDarkly Engineering 

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role.

About the Job 

As a Software Engineer on LaunchDarkly’s SDK team, you will build the primary touchpoint that our customers interact with on a daily basis. You’ll work with multiple technologies across our 35+ SDKs while enabling customers of all kinds to feature flag their code. When working on our SDKs, you’d be contributing to much more than thin client wrappers. Our SDKs are feature-rich agents with strong emphases on performance, concurrency, and resiliency -- all while following idiomatic practices for their tech stack.

LaunchDarkly serves trillions of feature flags daily to customers all around the globe, and every flag is handled by our SDKs. This team has a major impact not only on our company, but on our customers (and their customers). We are growing fast and we need your help writing the next chapter in our story.

Responsibilities: 

- 
Contribute to development for SDKs in supported platforms :

- 
Implement new features and improvements to meet customer performance and resiliency requirements

- 
Keep up to date with the latest development practices

- 
Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to drive the implementation and release of major features

- 
Actively maintain our open-source repositories

- 
Identify areas of improvement and advocate for best practices

- 
Have an active voice in shaping both technology and product decisions

Basic Qualifications:

- 
Demonstrable experience building libraries and packages used by other developers

- 
Polyglot background with an ability to context switch between languages quickly

- 
5+ years experience with at least two of the following: .NET/Go/Ruby/Python/NodeJS/Java

- 
Experience with the following is a plus:

- 
C++/Erlang/Haskell/Lua

- 
AI SDKs

- 
Observability SDKs

- 
Mobile development

- 
Strong computer science fundamentals

- 
Committed to working in a communicative, collaborative environment

- 
Self‐starter and problem solver, willing to solve difficult problems and work independently when necessary

- 
Strong testing background: experience building unit, integration, load tests, and benchmarks

- 
Experience writing production-ready code with emphasis on quality and maintainability

- 
Experience contributing to open-source software

Logistics:

- 
This is a remote role, with opportunities to visit the office in the Bay Area, California, for team offsites

- 
The SDK team is spread between Eastern and Pacific time zones

Highlights:

- 
You will work collaboratively with a team of highly experienced engineers who are amazing at the craft of engineering and building SDKs

- 
Your contributions will be publicly visible as the SDK team develops LaunchDarkly’s open-source SDKs in public

- 
LaunchDarkly uses our own SDKs. You will have opportunities working with the other teams within LaunchDarkly

- 
In this role, you can learn about many programming languages and frameworks

- 
You will have opportunities to strongly influence roadmap and prioritization

Pay: 

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3: 

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860 **

- Zone 3: All other US locations - $145,500 - $200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. 

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas. 
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary. 

About LaunchDarkly: 

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

- Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

- Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

- Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

- Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

- Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

title: Software Engineer, AI Enablement
description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale . If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! 

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role 

We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools.

Key Responsibilities 

- Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap.

- Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product.

- Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt.

- Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built.

- Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool.

- Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership.

What We Are Looking For 

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use

- Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation

- Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling

- A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate.

- Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team

- Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap

Nice to Have

- Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling

- Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents

- Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python

- Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer

- Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption

- Technical project management experience

- A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).

- Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.

title: Design Engineer, Site
description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Design Engineer (Site) to own https://infisical.com and show the world what we're about.

In this role, you'll work with engineering, design, and marketing to be the go-to person for everything having to do with building and maintaining the design and infrastructure of the landing page; we want this surface to be iconic and performant to drive organic traffic and user adoption.

This role is for someone who has a frontend-leaning full stack engineering background, who obsesses over crafting pixel-perfect experiences, cares about building sound underlying infrastructure, and is motivated to help build out our growth engine.

You'll work closely with our co-founder, engineering, design, and marketing to:

- 
Design and ship pixel-perfect, reusable components and complex designs.

- 
Build and maintain core website pages (home, product, blogs, learning/resource hub etc.), microsites, frontend architecture, code quality, CMS integration and experience.

- 
Implement SEO best practices, run A/B tests, and optimize conversion funnels.

- 
Integrate analytics, attribution, and marketing tooling - Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, HubSpot, etc.

Requirements 

- 
Deep mastery of JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and frameworks like React/Next.js.

- 
Experience building high-quality frontend systems and components with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

- 
Experience with web design and design systems.

- 
Exceptional attention to detail and eagerness to learn.

- 
Bias toward action: able to make decisions, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

- 
Based in the Americas (SF preferred) or able to work EST hours.

Nice to have 

- 
Technical SEO fundamentals.

- 
Experience with CMS platforms (e.g. Contentful, Sanity, etc.).

- 
Experience configuring website analytics/marketing platform integrations such as with Google Analytics and HubSpot.

- 
Experience with developer-facing products or startups.

Team, values & benefits 

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. 

Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. 

About the Role 

As our Principal AI Engineer, you will lead the design and implementation of production AI systems that solve real business problems for our partners and shape how Able builds. You were a Technical Founder, Co-founder, or founding engineer at an AI company. You have the scar tissue of taking something to market and learning why product-market fit is hard. You will set the technical bar for AI at Able, working at the spec and acceptance layer of an AI-native engineering model, and play a key role in establishing Able as a leader in the AI space.

What We’re Looking For 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities 

- Technical Leadership: you will lead technical conversations, be hands-on in building applications or proofs of concepts, and establish AI/ML guidelines and standards for our partners, prospects, and across the organization.

- Entrepreneurship: you will spot market opportunities to match technology with business outcomes, bringing a builder's instinct for what will and won't land commercially.

- AI Thought Leadership and Innovation: you will drive Able's AI strategy forward by constantly exploring and implementing cutting-edge AI technologies, frameworks, and tools.

- Consulting/Business Development: you will work with partners and prospects to understand their business and conceive of opportunities to introduce technology (AI specifically) to improve performance.

- AI Enablement: you will provide coaching and mentorship, continuously enhancing our team's and partner teams AI capabilities through knowledge sharing and training on the latest technology and best practices.

Required Skills & Experience 

- 12+ years building AI/ML systems, with production experience shipping and operating them

- Fluency with the modern LLM stack: frontier models, RAG, vector databases, agentic frameworks, and the evals and guardrails that make them trustworthy in production

- You operate in the spec-and-harness model, leveraging agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.,) at the spec and acceptance layer 

- Demonstrated experience leading large and complex projects

- Proven experience integrating ML and generative models with existing web and mobile applications

- Innate ability to effectively interact and inspire our partners and executive stakeholders on new AI ideas

- Demonstrated skill in connecting business challenges to the potential benefits of AI, and effectively communicating those opportunities to non-technical audiences

- Excellent English verbal and written communication

Nice to Have 

- Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with a strong focus on AI and Machine Learning

- Experience with MCP, graph-based retrieval, or multimodal pipelines

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect:

- To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.

- Payments made in USD.

- 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.

- Wellness + Remote Stipend

- AI Voucher

About Able 

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Who are we? 

At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

About the role 

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own a feature area within our Product Engineering team. You'll be the engineer your product manager turns to for "is this possible, and how big is it", leading technical design for your area and seeing it through to production. You'll shape how your squad builds, mentor the engineers around you, and have real influence over what we ship for customers who depend on us to understand their cyber risk.

You'll join one of our 11 (and growing) Product Engineering squads, most of which have a product manager, designer and technical lead alongside the engineers.

Our stack is React and TypeScript on the front end, Go services with Postgres as our primary database, running on Kubernetes via Google Cloud Platform.

Our engineers work with agentic coding tools, mostly Claude Code and Cursor, and a growing part of the product is LLM-backed. You'll work this way from day one, and we'll want your ideas on what to automate next, from how we write code to how we test, review, ship and run it.

What you'll do 

- 
Own a feature area end to end, from design conversations with product through to production and follow-up

- 
Lead technical design for your area and drive the architectural decisions within it

- 
Work with product and design to shape what we build: what's possible, what it costs, and what should come first

- 
Mentor the engineers around you and lift the quality of the squad's code and decisions

- 
Improve the reliability, scalability and performance of the systems you own

- 
Go deep on the cybersecurity domain and bring that understanding into what we build

What we're looking for 

- 
Typically 5+ years of relevant engineering experience at tech-centric, product-driven companies

- 
Strong TypeScript and React

- 
A backend language you're productive in (we use Go)

- 
Solid relational database skills (we use Postgres)

- 
AI coding tools as your default workflow, and the judgment to review and own what they produce

- 
Pragmatic trade-offs: you weigh technical quality against what the business needs now

- 
Low ego, high care: you're in it for the product and the customer, not just the code

- 
A track record of leading technical design for a feature area and seeing it through to production

- 
Experience mentoring engineers and lifting the quality of the code and decisions around you

What will give you an edge? 

- 
Cybersecurity experience

- 
Running services on Kubernetes, ideally on GCP

- 
Building complex applications or systems from the ground up with a cross-functional team

- 
Owning a service in production: on-call, observability, and the judgment to know what to fix now and what can wait

What's in it for you? 

We're fully remote, and we'd rather spend on things people actually use than on perks that look good in a job ad.

- 
Fully remote and flexible: work from anywhere in Australia. We have offices in Sydney and Hobart, a co-working allowance everywhere else, and no attendance mandate.

- 
Real face time: two off-sites a year, one with your squad and one with the wider Product team or the whole company, plus city-based socials in between, with colleagues who like spending time together.

- 
Stock options: every engineer gets equity, so you share in UpGuard's growth.

- 
Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

- 
18 weeks paid Parental Leave: irrespective of parenting role (all regions)

- 
Personal Leave allowance: this includes sick and carer’s leave.

- 
$[amount] monthly lifestyle subsidy for your financial, physical and mental wellbeing.

- 
US$1,500 annual learning and development allowance, spent on whatever helps your career, not just courses.

- 
WFH set-up allowance to get your home office right in your first three months.

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Please Note: Not all roles can be performed from the United States. Please check your specific job listing to confirm its advertised location. If the role you are applying for is listed as based in the US, we are currently only able to support hiring in the following locations: CA, CO, FL, IL, MA, MD, MO, OR, PA, TX, WA, and DC.

Before starting work with us, you will need to undertake a national police history check and reference checks.

title: Scout Junior Quality Coordinator - Spanish (Mexico)
description:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE 


Are you a search engine guru? Can you find what you're looking for with just a few keywords? We have a unique opportunity for you to put your skills to the test!

You will be the junior coordinator of our Search Quality Rater project.

Performance Analysis 


・May analyze data on quality performance, produce statistical quality reports, monitor progress, and create related documentation - with support from Quality Coordinators. 


・Completes Internal Assessments. 


・ Provides feedback on blind test ranges and queries coming from the team. 


・ May provide ad-hoc support to raters and educate them on best practices and client’s expectations.

Training and support

Analytics, Reporting, Knowledge, and Asset Management

Communication

・ Monitors raters’ queries. 



Other

Project Details 



Location: Remote, Mexico-based


Hours: 20hours/week


Start date: ASAP

REQUIRED SKILLS



- Fully Proficient in Spanish (Mexico)

- Strong understanding of English

- Must be located in Mexico

- Strong understanding of popular culture in Spanish (Mexico)

- Must be dedicated only to "Search Quality rating program" and NOT other search or ads rating programs

- Must not have current or previous experience with "Ads quality rating"

- Web-savvy and able to work in a fast-paced environment

- Excellent online research skills

- Reliable computer system and internet connection 

- Reliable anti-virus software (as you will be surfing the web as part of the work)

- Ability to follow instructions in English and comply with the project conventions and rules expected by the client

- Must sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement to protect client confidentiality

- Must pass learning modules and a required quality test designed by our client before starting work


Compensation


Additional Information


When you join Welocalize, you have the opportunity to bring your career to the next level: 


... receive steady volume of work and long-term partnership {where this applies} 


... professional development: work on exciting projects that will empower you keep learning and growing


... work with multicultural, international team with a great variety of documents and content types 


... 24-hour 6-day a week support from our Community team.



If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, apply below.

title: Technical Lead Manager
description:
About Us: 

Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home. 

We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us.

About The Role: 

We're hiring a Tech Lead Manager (Staff+) to lead a small team building the platform that is modernizing homebuilding. This is a leadership-track role for a senior engineer ready to grow their scope and impact. You'll stay hands-on as a technical leader while directly managing a team of 2–4 engineers.

The role blends deep technical ownership with people leadership. You'll set technical direction for your domain, ship production-grade code, and be accountable for the growth, output, and delivery of your team. The work spans the full stack and covers both internal tools that power construction operations and customer-facing experiences for homeowners and trades.

We're a remote-first team. You'll work from wherever you do your best work, with regular offsites to get together in person. You'll own entire product areas, make real technical decisions, and work directly with engineering leadership, product, and design to take features from concept to production.

What You'll Do: 

Technical Leadership: 

- 
Set technical direction for your domain. Contribute to architecture decisions, API contracts, and data models that shape how our systems scale and evolve.

- 
Design, build, and deliver features across the platform. You own the full lifecycle from technical design through deployment and monitoring.

- 
Stay hands-on. Write and deploy high-quality, production-grade code on a regular basis.

- 
Raise the bar across engineering. Review designs, improve developer experience, and help other engineers work through complex problems.

People Leadership: 

- 
Directly manage a team of 2–4 engineers. Hold regular 1:1s, give clear and actionable feedback, and lead growth and performance conversations.

- 
Own your team's delivery. Drive planning, prioritization, and execution, and be accountable for outcomes.

- 
Coach and develop your engineers. Help them grow their skills, scope, and careers, and create the conditions for them to do their best work.

- 
Partner with product and design to translate messy, real-world processes into clean, reliable software and to make tradeoffs that balance speed and quality.

- 
Help grow the team. Recruit, interview, and raise the bar on who we hire.

About You: 

- 
10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping products that land real-world impact.

- 
Experience as a tech lead, team lead, or engineering manager. You've led projects and/or people, whether formally or informally, and prior direct management experience is a strong plus.

- 
Built and delivered full-stack features across modern web technologies. Our stack includes TypeScript, Node, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS. We care more about your ability to learn and build than checking every box.

- 
Actively using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) in your daily workflow. You can explain how they change the way you approach problems and how you'd bring that leverage to a team.

- 
Demonstrated leadership and ownership. Mentoring engineers, influencing technical direction, and being the person people depend on.

- 
Designed systems that balance quick iterations with long-term reliability and maintainability.

- 
Partnered with product, design, and non-technical stakeholders to define requirements, make tradeoffs, and deliver outcomes. Not just code.

Who You Are: 

- 
You want to grow your scope and impact through leadership, both technical and people.

- 
You care about the people on your team. Their growth, their output, and their experience.

- 
You take ownership and seek autonomy over your work and outcomes.

- 
You're excited to build and lead within a small, nimble, high-impact team.

- 
You are self-directed. Comfortable prioritizing your own work and your team's with minimal oversight.

- 
You communicate clearly and proactively. Especially in writing.

- 
You're humble, good-natured, and bring positive energy to your tea

Our Commitment :

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Backend (USA Only - 100% Remote)
description:
About Us

Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale.

We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales.

Our Stack

Our backend tech stack consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our TaskTiger scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElastiCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. We have CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to Kubernetes clusters. We also use these images in our local development environment allowing coding locally against all of our services. We have a well-documented public API that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. Our infrastructure is heavily automated using Terraform, Ansible and other AWS tools. 

We love open sourcing our code and ideas on our GitHub and on The Making of Close , our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like SocketShark , TaskTiger , LimitLion and ciso8601 .

AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting. 

Our Teams

When you apply, you’ll have an opportunity to highlight the team that appeals to you the most. We’ll do our best to honor this preference, but we'll also be evaluating skillset fit and the needs of the business.

One thing to know up front: we do move people between teams as the work shifts. Most engineers here end up on more than one team over their time at Close - this team is where you’ll start, but over time you’ll likely have the opportunity to work on many different projects.

The work splits roughly like this. Pick the team that excites you most:

- 
Agents. Build Close’s agentic platform and customer-facing AI experiences. Voice Agents, Custom Agents, and Ask Chloe are already in flight. You’d work on the shared intelligence and orchestration layer that powers AI-driven processes across the product. That includes the ecosystem around our APIs and MCP surface, which enables external agents like Claude and ChatGPT to operate Close. This team is pushing deeper into applied AI, retrieval, and agent infrastructure more than ever before.

- 
Communications. Own the voice, SMS, and email infrastructure powering Close — Twilio, WebRTC, WebSockets, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, and more. You’ll help build our voice, messaging, and conversational AI agents while scaling real-time AI across calls, email, and calendar sync infrastructure.

- 
CRM. Build the structured context layer that humans and agents both depend on. We're rebuilding the data model so it flexes with real businesses, making the CRM agent-ready (retrieval, traversal, action coverage through MCP and our public API), and shipping the next generation of AI-native CRM features (AI Enrich, Autofill, AI Search). Operating on billions of Mongo documents with Elasticsearch underneath.

- 
Growth. Run the experiments and own the billing infrastructure that turn trials into paid customers. Stripe metered billing, AI credit top-ups, the activation and conversion funnel, and the team's biggest bet right now: agentic onboarding (an agent that walks new customers through setup, configuration, and first comms). Hypothesis-driven, metric-first.

You Are

- 
A seasoned engineer. Python is our backbone, but perhaps you’ve worked across Go, Rust, or TypeScript. You pick the right tool for the problem rather than retreating to what you know. You’ve seen a variety of problems, can collaborate and self-direct.

- 
Building AI. You've shipped LLM-backed features for real users and have a POV on where they're trustworthy, where they fall over, and how to get them production-ready when customers bet revenue on the output. We use Pydantic, Temporal, LangFuse, and other modern AI infrastructure tooling to power our agent platform.

- 
Working with AI in your day-to-day. You use AI tools in your own workflow to ship faster, write tighter code, and reason about unfamiliar parts of the codebase. We fund the use of AI tools (Claude Code, Codex and other best-in-class developer tools) and treat learning and experimentation as part of the work.

- 
A builder first. You’d rather get the first iteration of a feature in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks fretting over a perfect PR. You ship.

- 
Opinionated about API design for modern software. You've shipped internet-facing APIs and you think about who's on the other end - apps, agents, humans poking around in docs - and what each of them needs.

- 
Battle-tested. You've debugged incidents where latency budgets didn't hold, owned a system everyone else relied on, or carried a pager for something with real customer impact.

Benefits

- 
Compensation: Competitive pay plus an organization-wide goal-based bonus

- 
Paid Time Off: ~5 weeks of PTO to start. Plus a 1-week all-company Winter Holiday Break and paid US holidays. You'll earn 2 extra days for every year you're with Close.

- 
80% Work Option: Work with your manager to choose between a standard 5-day week or a 4-day week at 80% pay

- 
Parental Leave: Paid leave for primary and secondary caregivers

- 
Sabbatical: A 1-month paid sabbatical every 5 years with the team

- 
Healthcare (US residents): Two medical plans with Close covering 99% of your premium, plus Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, and company-paid Long-Term Disability

- 
401k (US residents): We match your contributions up to 6%, vested immediately

Our Values

Build a house you want to live in - Examine long-term thinking and action

No BS - Practice transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

Invest in each other - Build successful relationships with your coworkers and customers

Discipline equals freedom - Keep your word to yourself and others

Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others

Learn More

Listen to our CEO and Founder, Steli Efti, tell the story of Close’s journey in the $0-30m Blueprint . 

Watch our culture video from our 2023 team retreat in Milan. Every year our entire team gathers in person to build connection, foster cross-functional collaboration, and have fun. In 2027, we're headed to Dusseldorf, Germany! 

Explore our product. Check out a demo !

Our Hiring Process

We ask a few role-specific questions as part of our application process. These questions are designed to help us learn more about you from the start, so please answer each one thoughtfully. We see this as an opportunity to get to know you beyond your resume.

We use AI tools daily at Close and expect candidates to do the same. In evaluating your application, we aim to get a sense for you - the way you think, how you communicate, the work you've done. Applications that read as fully AI-generated will not be considered.

Regardless of fit, you can expect to hear back from our team with an update on the status of your candidacy.

If you progress to the interview process, you'll receive a full outline of the role-specific steps in your first touchpoint with us. We do our best to make the hiring process clear and human.

description:

title: C++/Rust Graphics and Windowing System Software Engineer - Mir
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a C++/Rust Graphics and Windowing System Software Engineer. 

We build Mir – a high-performance, high-efficiency technology stack for window managers, display subsystems and solutions built on top of it, like Ubuntu Frame. Leading with vision, we shape the technology stack that empowers communities to realize a world where apps work seamlessly in every graphical environment. 

Our goal is to enable the whole spectrum of graphics from single-purpose screens through edge devices to full desktop environments. We also set the pace for graphics enablement across the Ubuntu certified hardware ecosystem. Our daily drill includes design, development and testing of features as well as working with the community and responding to issues and user inquiries. 

Most of the software is written in C++, with support tooling in scripting languages. We will use Rust as an evolutionary step forward. Thus candidates are required to have strong skills in both Rust and C++. We're growing the team and looking for new colleagues who share our passion for precision, performance and user experience. We are hiring on various career levels with a minimum of 2 years industry experience. We are looking for people who ideally have experience in building window compositing systems or graphics device experience. We're committed to creating an outstanding developer experience, secure foundations, and easy access to today's most used graphics toolkits and libraries.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on modern display technologies that will impact millions of developers and users. Canonical offers a fast-paced team environment and a career full of learning and development opportunities across the open source spectrum.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA or APAC region.

The role entails


- Design and implementation of features across the Mir stack

- Assisting in debugging, tracking down and fixing issues

- Participating in our engineering process through code and architectural review

- Creating and improving tests and performance benchmarks to catch issues early

- Creating and maintaining documentation to enhance the developer experience

- Engaging with the open source community and commercial partners

- Collaborating proactively with a distributed team

What we are looking for in you


- Excellent Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar and 2+ years of working experience

- Excellent modern C++ and excellent Rust programming skills

- Familiarity with Linux as a development and deployment platform

- Ability to collaborate remotely with a diverse set of team members and remain highly motivated, productive, and organized

- Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills


- You have experience with the Wayland protocol ecosystem and compositors

- You are familiar with OpenGL, Vulkan, Flutter and other graphics, toolkits and animation frameworks

- You have a solid understanding of asynchronous programming and concurrency patterns

- You have proven ability to consistently deliver robust code to production

- You have strong written and verbal communication skills to document and present software developed

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.


- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

- Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

- Annual compensation review

- Recognition rewards

- Annual holiday leave

- Maternity and paternity leave

- Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

- Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer 

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Staff Software Engineer, App Platform
description:
About Us 

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners—specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. We build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We're based in San Francisco, CA, and built remote-first. We're backed by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, and more. Over 50 of the top 100 accounting and consulting firms trust Fieldguide to power mission-critical work.

About the Role

As a Staff Platform Engineer at Fieldguide, you will design and build the foundational platform that powers Fieldguide, including core platform services and tooling that make it fast, safe, and consistent to deliver new capabilities to customers. This is the platform on which every product surface and AI agent at Fieldguide is built.

You will operate as a technical leader across teams, defining standards and reducing complexity for product, AI, and infrastructure engineers. Your work will directly shape how Fieldguide can ship quickly for our largest enterprise customers while keeping our systems reliable and scalable.

What You’ll Own

- Lead the design and evolution of Fieldguide's core platform services, including the foundational systems, APIs, and shared primitives that every product surface and agent depends on

- Build platform capabilities that compound the leverage of product and AI engineers, turning hard problems into reusable building blocks

- Define the architecture for how new product capabilities get delivered across our SaaS, enterprise single-tenant, and government-cloud environments

- Partner directly with product, design, and AI engineering leaders to understand customer needs and translate them into platform investments

- Drive cross-team initiatives that improve product velocity, system reliability, and consistency across the application

- Own the standards for service design, data modeling, and platform integration patterns used across Fieldguide

- Maintain and evolve the internal developer platform that supports the team, including deployment tooling, and agentic engineering capabilities

- Mentor senior and mid-level engineers across the org and raise the bar for platform engineering at Fieldguide

Who You Are

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant time spent building product-facing platforms or foundational application services

- Strong product instincts and a track record of shipping platform capabilities that unlocked meaningful customer outcomes

- Deep experience designing APIs, services, and shared systems that other engineers build on top of

- Strong fluency with modern cloud platforms (AWS preferred), Kubernetes, and distributed systems

- Track record of operating as a technical leader across multiple teams without owning them directly

- Excellent judgment on what to build into the platform, what to leave to product teams, and what to buy

- Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to contribute to and review complex codebases

- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to drive alignment across engineering, product, and design

- High agency and a bias toward owning problems end-to-end

Bonus Points

- Experience building platforms that power AI-native products, including agent frameworks, model orchestration, or LLM-powered application surfaces

- Experience designing platforms that support both multi-tenant SaaS and single-tenant enterprise deployments

- Experience as a founding or early platform engineer at a vertical SaaS or enterprise AI company

Benefits

- Competitive compensation with equity

- Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

- Flexible time off and work schedules

- Technology reimbursements

- 401(k) plan

- Twice-yearly in-person offsites across the U.S.

- Wellness benefits starting on your first day

Our Values

- Fearless — Inspire and break down seemingly impossible walls

- Fast — Launch fast with excellence; iterate to perfection

- Lovable — Deliver happiness and 11-star experiences

- Owners — Execute and run the business with ownership

- Win-win — Create mutual value and earn trust for life

- Inclusive — Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams

title: Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product​
description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! 

Why this role matters:

BSS Engineering and Product is a critical enabler of Vonage's commercial platform, ensuring our business support systems are scalable, reliable, commercially aligned, and able to support growth across products, regions, and customer segments. As Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product, you will lead the global BSS function across engineering ownership, product direction, platform strategy, and delivery for billing, rating, provisioning, ordering, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations.

Your key responsibilities:

BSS Engineering Leadership 

- Lead the global BSS engineering organization, owning architecture, delivery, quality, resilience, technical standards, and platform performance across core BSS systems

- Define engineering practices across solution design, integration, release management, test automation, observability, and technical debt management

- Ensure BSS platforms support scale, availability, security, compliance, and the needs of a multi-product, multi-region commercial model.

BSS Product Ownership & Roadmap 

- Own the BSS product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing capabilities against commercial, customer, operational, regulatory, and finance needs

- Translate business requirements into a clear product backlog across billing, rating, mediation, ordering, CPQ, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations

- Establish governance, prioritization forums, success measures, and communication rhythms, including the use of AI-enabled insight and automation to improve delivery, decision-making, and platform optimisation.

Team Leadership & Operating Cadence 

- Lead and develop a global BSS Engineering and Product team, including engineering managers, product owners, platform leads, architects, and delivery specialists

- Run an effective operating cadence across roadmap planning, delivery governance, platform health, stakeholder prioritisation, risk management, and product delivery progress

- Build organisational capability through hiring, succession planning, team structure design, globally distributed delivery, and practical AI enablement across engineering and product ways of working.

What you'll bring:

Required: 

- Senior BSS engineering and product leadership experience in global telecommunications, CPaaS, cloud communications, or enterprise SaaS

- Deep BSS domain expertise, including platforms such as Amdocs, Oracle Communications, CSGi, NetCracker, Zuora, Optiva, Salesforce CPQ, or equivalent

- Experience leading BSS platform delivery, including migrations, integrations, data improvement, release planning, and API-led or cloud-native architectures where appropriate

- Strong product ownership capability, with experience translating commercial, finance, regulatory, operational, and customer needs into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes

- Experience leading geographically distributed engineering, product, architecture, and delivery teams in a matrixed environment, with a track record of using AI, automation, or data-driven tooling to improve productivity, quality, and platform outcomes.

Experience we consider a plus: 

- Experience in CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or Tier 1/Tier 2 telecommunications

- Experience with API monetisation, partner billing, usage-based charging, subscription management, or digital self-service.

How you'll benefit

- Private Medical Insurance: Adeslas

- Group Pension Plan: Generali

- Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident: VidaCaixa

- Ericsson Care Line

- Discretionary Time Off (DTO)/Hourly Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Volunteer Time (VTO)

- Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process.

#LI-KF1

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice . 

Who we are: 

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.
